texts.zh:
就像暗室里低沉的轻语般，虚境从内心召唤我们。那是时间开始运转的伊始便存在的由纯粹灵能构成的原生领域。所有被赐予灵能能力的生物都能用某种方式，即使只是潜意识地，从虚境汲取能量。

自从我们升格之后，我们开始更清晰地看到虚境。其中有些图案，即使是我们最强大的通灵者看到的也只是毫无格式的漩涡状能量。在虚境那边，也有一些……其他的存在。一种灵体样的存在，从另一边凝视着我们，有时怀着好奇，有时怀着善意……有时也怀着恶意。

我们还在进一步学习我们这新得力量的延展面，但我们还是有可能和这些灵体交流的，这需要我们最强大的通灵者们的共同努力。
texts.en:
Like a muffled whisper in a dark room, the Shroud calls to us from within our minds. It is a primordial realm of pure psychic energy that came into being at the dawn of time. All creatures that have been gifted with psionic abilities tap into the Shroud in some way to draw power, even if only subconsciously.

Since our transcendence, we have begun to see the Shroud with greater clarity. There are patterns where once even our strongest telepaths could see only a formless mass of swirling energy. There are... other things, as well. Spirits of a sort, that gaze back on us from the other side. Sometimes with curiosity, sometimes with kindness... and sometimes with malice.

We are still in the process of learning the extent of our new powers, but it may be possible for us to commune with these spirits. It will require the combined efforts of our most powerful telepaths.

texts.zh:
我们的命运与轮回之终末绑定在一起；祂的光环所到之处，我们的人口便兴盛繁衍。我们得到了一个简单的结论：妨碍光环就是妨碍[This.GetName]，就该彻底铲除。

只要愿意，我们加可以抛开对军事目标的一切限制，毫不留情地征服敌人。没有什么可以阻挡终末的上上善道。
texts.en:
Our fate is bound to the End of the Cycle; wherever its Aura flourishes, so too does our population. A simple conclusion has arisen within us: anything that impedes the Aura impedes the [This.GetName], and so must be eliminated.

Should we wish it, we can cast aside any existing limits on our military aims and conquer our enemies without mercy. Nothing need stand in the way of the End's supremacy.

texts.zh: 随着终末光环渐渐填满星系，我们感受到了越来越强烈的抵抗。我们敌人的反感正变得越来越根深蒂固。但这都无足轻重，因为我们不会坐等其他帝国接纳轮回之终末的。
texts.en: As the Aura of the End suffuses the galaxy, we sense a growing resistance. Our enemies' antipathy is becoming ever more entrenched. It matters not; we will not wait for others to embrace the End of the Cycle.

texts.zh: 随着终末光环渐渐填满星系，我们感受到了越来越强烈的抵抗。我们的遥邻很快就向我们发难。但这都无足轻重，因为我们不会坐等其他帝国接纳轮回之终末的。
texts.en: As the Aura of the End suffuses the galaxy, we sense a growing resistance. Our distant neighbors are rapidly turning against us. It matters not; we will not wait for others to embrace the End of the Cycle.

texts.zh: 受超主意愿的启发，我们发明了一种消耗能量和物质来充能光环的新方法。可以献祭这个宇宙的物质来推进终末。
texts.en: Inspired by our patron's will, we have devised new methods of expending energy and matter to fuel the Aura. The very stuff of the universe may be sacrificed to advance the End.

label.en: We must do all that is necessary.

texts.zh:
我们的超主无言而说。我们感受到了轮回终末的迫近，新的能量也随之在[This.GetName]中涌动。这种紧迫感鼓舞着我们。

如果我们想令终末之意满足，所有[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural]就需要把一切力量集中到同一个方向上。我们必须显现超主的力量，将祂的光环延伸到星系的最远处。
texts.en:
Our patron speaks silently. As we sense the imminence of cycle's end, renewed energy surges throughout the [This.GetName]. We are invigorated with urgency.

If we wish to satisfy the will of the End, the collective energy of all [This.GetSpeciesNamePlural] must be applied toward one purpose. We must manifest our patron's power, and complete the spread of its Aura to the furthest reaches of the galaxy.

texts.zh:
经过了数天的催眠出神后，灵能使密会的通灵者们终于开启了一道通往虚境的短暂穿界门。

现在已经建立了初步的灵能链接，以后就能通过接触菜单和虚境交流了。为了和这一领域建立有意义的连接并会见身居其中的存在，我们有必要用一种特殊的灵能发射器延展灵能范围，这会消耗一笔巨量的能量。
texts.en:
After days of being locked in an hypnotic trance, our psychics in the Conclave of Telepaths have finally managed to open a brief gateway into the Shroud.

Now that we have established an initial psionic link, we will be able to access the Shroud through the Contacts menu in the future. To make any kind of meaningful forays into this realm and meet the beings who dwell there, we will likely have to make use of special psionic emitters to extend our psychic reach. This will consume a tremendous amount of energy.

label.zh: 是时候进入了，看看我们能发现什么。
label.en: Time to reach in and see what we find.

texts.zh:
在逐渐突破帷幕的过程中，我们可以感受到它在我们联合意识的施压下逐渐变得稀薄起来。而我们尝试突入虚境的行为在另一端看来并非波澜不惊。有什么东西正在注视着我们。

这个存在散发着强大的力量和深不可测的意图。它在逐渐渗入我们心灵的裂缝中。

它仅仅是注意到了我们，就像观察着舷窗上凝结的一滴水一般观察着我们。也许这个存在会允许我们进入，这样我们才能与其神秘的意识发生接触。
texts.en:
While we have yet to actually pierce the veil, we can feel it getting thinner and thinner under the pressure of our combined minds. Yet, on the other side, our efforts to enter the Shroud have not gone unnoticed. Something watches us.

Its presence radiates phenomenal power and unfathomable purpose. It seeps through the cracks of our psyche.

It barely notices us. It watches us like we would a drop of condensation on a porthole. It might let us in, if only we could reach its inscrutable mind.

label.zh: 这不是什么好主意！我们得小心为妙。
label.en: This was a terrible idea! We must be more careful.

texts.zh: 自从与[GetShroudPatron]签订契约以来又过了些许时日。我们之间联系的纽带仍旧脆弱，因此仍有将其打破亦或是增强的机会。
texts.en: Some time has passed since we established the foundation of a Covenant with the [GetShroudPatron]. Our bond is still weak, so we still have a chance to break it - or to strengthen it.

texts.zh: 我们的灵能使在不依靠虚境住民的帮助下不眠不休地尝试突破虚境。终于，他们发现了一条通路。这片深渊正在召唤我们。我们只需要深吸一口气跃入其中。
texts.en: Our telepaths have toiled tirelessly to breach the Shroud with no help from its denizens. At last, they found a way in. This abyss calls to us. We need only dare to take the plunge.

label.zh: 那我们就潜入虚境的深处吧。
label.en: Into the shrouded depths we go.

texts.zh:
我们对自己超主的理解与日俱增。我们对于祂来说只不过是茶余饭后的闲思遐绪。房室内的虫子。然而，是祂对我们降下了恩宠，而且非常偶然地，它对我们施予了又一汪能源之滴露。

我们的灵能使现在和超主愈发地协调，受到鼓舞我们计划建立一座纪念碑来铭记我们的刻印，在这里我们最为杰出的灵能使可以尝试与[GetShroudPatron]进行沟通。
texts.en:
Our understanding of our patron grows. We are no more than an afterthought to it. Insects in its home. Yet, it has taken a liking to us and on this occasion, it has bestowed another drop of power upon us.

Our telepaths are now more closely attuned to our patron, and we have been inspired to create a monument to celebrate our covenant, a place where our best telepaths can try to commune with the [GetShroudPatron].

label.zh: 在织缕的怀抱中我们觉得更为安全。
label.en: We feel safer in the Composer's embrace.

label.zh: 我们也饥饿了。战争能够让我们饱腹。
label.en: We hunger too. War can sate us.

label.zh: 没有什么比欲念更为美丽。
label.en: There is nothing more beautiful than desire.

label.zh: 充盈的心灵容不下迟疑。
label.en: A filled mind has no room for doubt.

texts.zh: 虚境的神秘对于我们来说异乎寻常，难以消弭，但是我们和[GetShroudPatron]的协调更加融顺了。无论我们去往哪里，我们都能感受到它在我们思绪的背后，它的能量渗过心灵的缝隙进入我们的现实。
texts.en: The mysteries of the Shroud are too alien for us to dispel, but we have become more attuned to the [GetShroudPatron]. Everywhere we go, we can sense it at the back of our minds, and its power seeps into our reality from the cracks of our psyche.

label.en: The will of the Flesh is sacred.

texts.zh:
我们的超主，[GetShroudPatron]，从虚境中沉积出了一小份能量以备取用。与超主的紧密关系让我们能安全吸收这些能量。

我们挑选了一些候选人，但只有其中一位可以得到获得汲取超主力量的殊荣。我们必须做出抉择。
texts.en:
Our patron, the [GetShroudPatron], has deposited a fraction of its energy in a fold of the Shroud, ready for the taking. Our close bond will allow one of us to safely absorb this power.

A number of candidates have been selected, but only one of them can be granted the privilege to wield the power of our patron. We must decide who it shall be.

texts.zh: 完成了。随着力量被注入到[chosen_leader.GetName]体内，身旁的人们都能[GetFeelLoc]到这灵能显昭的分量，这让他们肃然起敬。[chosen_leader.GetHeSheCap]现在成为了[GetImmortalLoc]的[This.GetName]虚境塑造者。
texts.en: It is done. As the power was invested in [chosen_leader.GetName], all those around could [GetFeelLoc] the weight of its psionic presence. It is powerful and commands respect. [chosen_leader.GetHeSheCap] will now be the [GetImmortalLoc]  Shroudshaper of the [This.GetName].

texts.zh: 完成了。随着力量被注入到[chosen_leader.GetName]体内，身旁的人们都能[GetFeelLoc]到这灵能显昭的分量，这让他们肃然起敬。[chosen_leader.GetHeSheCap]现在成为了[GetImmortalLoc]的[GetShroudPatron]捍卫者。
texts.en: It is done. As the power was invested in [chosen_leader.GetName], all those around could [GetFeelLoc] the weight of its psionic presence. It is powerful and commands respect. [chosen_leader.GetHeSheCap] will now be the [GetImmortalLoc]  champion of the [GetShroudPatron].

texts.zh: 这次事件给[previous_chosen_leader.GetName]，一位曾被旧主选中的异端，带来了毁灭性打击。在[previous_chosen_leader.GetHisHer]的流放地，随着最后一丝灵能从[previous_chosen_leader.GetHisHer]支离破碎的躯体中消散，这位异端的生命也随之走到了尽头。
texts.en: The event had a devastating effect on the heretic [previous_chosen_leader.GetName], once considered the Chosen of our former patron. From [previous_chosen_leader.GetHisHer] place of exile, [previous_chosen_leader.GetHeShe] quietly expired when the last traces of psionic power ebbed from [previous_chosen_leader.GetHisHer] broken form.

texts.zh: 该事件对[chosen_leader_lost_patron.GetName]产生了显著影响。尽管[chosen_leader_lost_patron.GetHeShe]依旧蕴含强大的灵能能量，却失去了昔日由旧主庇护在[chosen_leader_lost_patron.GetHimHer]躯体中赋予的力量。
texts.en: The event had a noticeable effect on [chosen_leader_lost_patron.GetName]. Though still imbued with considerable psionic energy, [chosen_leader_lost_patron.GetHeShe] [chosen_leader_lost_patron.GetHasHave] lost the power once bestowed in [chosen_leader_lost_patron.GetHimHer] by our former patron.

label.en: They were destined to be Chosen.

texts.zh:
灵能使密会在研究如何利用超主[GetShroudPatron]的力量方面取得了突破性进展。在从前，只有激发了灵能的个体可以完全领悟契约的内涵，我们已经开发了一种能让这股力量贯穿整艘星舰的方法，这是此前从未达到过的程度。

只要我们想，[GetShroudPatron]的力量能将我们的舰船推进得比以往更远。
texts.en:
The Conclave of Telepaths has made a breakthrough in harnessing the powers of our patron, the [GetShroudPatron]. Where previously only psionic individuals could fully grasp the extent of the Covenant, we have devised a way to let power flow through entire starships, at a scale never seen before.

Should we wish it, the mark of the [GetShroudPatron] can push our ships further than ever before.

label.en: What is a hull if not flesh?

label.zh: 秘密是无可匹敌的武器。

texts.zh:
虚境。它是如此怪异，如此令人不安，却让人瞬间觉得……熟悉。任何有灵能能力的人都在梦中见到过这里，虽然他们当时可能并不知情。

我们如今徘徊在这虚境边陲的峭壁上，距离虚境与普通空间——或称“现实世界”之间的虚空间隙仅咫尺之遥。

为了探索深层次的虚境，我们需要在通灵上付出巨大贡献，还需要一笔巨额的能量，我们绝对不能草率对待……即使是现在，我们被注视着。
texts.en:
The Shroud. It is unbelievably strange and unsettling, but also... immediately familiar. Anyone with psionic powers will have seen this place in their dreams, though they likely did not know it at the time.

We linger now at the precipice of this realm, not far from the empty void of the Inbetween that serves as the boundary between here and normal space - or what we would call the real world.

To venture deeper into the Shroud will require great effort on the part of our telepaths, as well as a large amount of energy. We must not dally... even now, we are being watched.

texts.zh: 虚境今天很平静。
texts.en: The Shroud is quiet today.

texts.zh: 某种存在在注视着我们。
texts.en: Something is watching us.

texts.zh: 从这一面看，一切变得如此不同。
texts.en: It all looks so different on this side.

texts.zh: 他们应该派个诗人过来……
texts.en: They should have sent a poet...

texts.zh: 某种黑暗之物来了。
texts.en: Something dark is coming.

texts.zh: 我们还在梦里吗？
texts.en: Are we still dreaming?

texts.zh: 我们……我们办到了！我们在里面！
texts.en: We... we made it. We're inside!

texts.zh: 某种……存在，徘徊在附近。它召唤我们前往虚境更深处……
texts.en: A... presence, of sorts, lingers nearby. It beckons us deeper into the Shroud...

texts.zh: 你也听到了那声音？
texts.en: Do you hear the voices too?

texts.zh: 虚境的脉动强而有力。感觉像……家一样。
texts.en: The Shroud pulsates with power. It feels like... home.

texts.zh: 你觉得你现在呼吸的是空气吗？
texts.en: Do you think that is air you're breathing now?

texts.zh: 我们见，我们不曾见，这地方还有许多有待我们学习的东西。
texts.en: We see, and yet we do not see. There is so much to learn about this place.

texts.zh: 我们缺失了什么感官，为什么我们无法看到，听到我们周遭的另一个世界？
texts.en: What senses do we lack that we cannot see and cannot hear another world all around us?

texts.zh: 保持最谨慎的状态。在这里即使是一个妄想也能被塑性成可触及的事物……而且，往往会袭击我们。
texts.en: Take the greatest of care. Even a stray thought can be shaped into something tangible in this place... and, more often than not, turned against oneself.

texts.zh: 我们永远都不应在这的。
texts.en: We were never meant to be here.

texts.zh: 如此……多的……能量……
texts.en: So... much... power...

texts.zh: 保持……专注……
texts.en: Must... focus...

texts.zh: 这就是一切的起源之地吗？
texts.en: Could this be where everything began?

texts.zh: 恐怖……有形的恐怖。
texts.en: Horror... horror has a face.

texts.zh: 虚境和之前已经完全不一样了。肯定有什么东西错了。
texts.en: The Shroud is not what it once was. Something is very wrong.

texts.zh: 居住在虚境的实体们陷入了巨大的痛苦。一股压倒一切的战栗感渗透进了一切。
texts.en: The entities that reside within the Shroud are in anguish. An almost overwhelming sense of terror permeates everything.

texts.zh: 很难……集中注意力。万事万物都在涌动，万事万物都在……痛苦。
texts.en: It is... difficult to focus. Everything is in flux, and there is so much... pain.

texts.zh: 虚境正在整片区域整片区域地开始……枯萎。我们找不到其他的形容方式。
texts.en: Entire segments of the Shroud have... shrivelled. It can be described in no other way.

texts.zh: 巨大的黑暗正在虚境之中蔓延，腐蚀其触碰到的一切。
texts.en: A great darkness is spreading throughout the Shroud, corrupting everything it touches.

texts.zh: 虚境之中有了全新的存在。其黑暗的影响力遍布四处。一切都在发生变化。
texts.en: There is a new presence in the Shroud. Its dark influence is felt everywhere. Everything is changing.

label.en: Reach out to a higher power.
Reach out to the Animator of Clay.

texts.zh: 我们知道这里潜藏着巨大的力量。虽然我们一度被忽视，但如果能利用好泽珞的力量便能够尝试进行探寻。我们的灵能使在整个虚境中探测到了这些实体。我们应该去寻访哪一位？
texts.en: We know that there are vast powers out there. While we'd usually go unnoticed, we could try to reach out by tapping into the powers of Zro. All over the Shroud, the influence of these entities is felt by our telepaths. Which one should we seek out?

label.en: One that reeks of flesh unbound.
One that screams of emptiness insatiable.
One that whispers of longing and possession.
One that tastes like broken trust.

texts.zh:
灵能使密会所还没有从上一次参观虚境的压力中恢复过来。没有他们的共通灵能，我们只能捕捉到这个飞逝领域的一瞥，就像记忆的模糊边界一样遥不可及。

而这目前不能提供给我们什么，我们只能之后再来。
texts.en:
The Conclave of Telepaths has not yet recovered from the strain of our previous visit to the Shroud. Without their combined psionic power, we can catch only brief glimpses of this fleeting realm - like the blurred edges of a memory lying just beyond reach.

There is nothing for us here. We will have to return later.

texts.zh:
虚境强大的能量已被成功地注入一个处于我们的控制之下的灵能化身！

在转移至我们的维度后，这个新生的化身已合并为一个太空实体，并处在[Root.Capital.GetName]轨道上。
texts.en:
The powerful energies of the Shroud have been successfully channeled into a psionic Avatar under our control!

After translating into our dimension, the newborn Avatar has coalesced into a spacefaring entity in orbit over [Root.Capital.GetName].

texts.zh:
虚境强大的能量已被成功地注入一个处于我们的控制之下的灵能化身！

在转移至我们的维度后，这个新生的化身已合并为一个巨型武士，并处在[Root.Capital.GetName]地表上。
texts.en:
The powerful energies of the Shroud have been successfully channeled into a psionic Avatar under our control!

After translating into our dimension, the newborn Avatar has coalesced into a colossal warrior on the surface of [Root.Capital.GetName].

texts.zh: 用来召唤一个化身并将其带至我们维度所需导通的灵能已超越我们目前的能力。因为我们的失败，虚境的能量摇曳至尽。
texts.en: Channelling the psionic power required to summon an Avatar and bring it into our dimension is simply beyond our current ability. The energies of the Shroud fizzle with agitation as our attempt fails.

texts.zh:
召唤化身的尝试只成功了一部分。虽然这个造物已经以正确的形态显现到我们的维度中，但[GetTelepathPlural]们未能将其驯服！

我们现在要面对一个敌对的灵能实体，它将摧毁沿途的一切。
texts.en:
The attempt to summon a psionic Avatar was only partially successful. Although the creature assumed its correct form and translated into our dimension, our [GetTelepathPlural] failed to bring it under our control!

We are now faced with an aggressive psionic entity that will destroy everything in its path.

texts.zh: 一个虚境造物突破了空间壁垒，并且在[shroud_spawn_system.GetName]星系完成实体化！这个复仇心切的化身驾驭着一股强大的灵能，并将用其鞭挞任何不幸踏上它复仇之路的人和物。
texts.en: A creature of the Shroud has pierced the fabric of space and materialized in the [shroud_spawn_system.GetName] system! This vengeful Avatar has amassed a tremendous amount of psionic energy and is using it to lash out at anything and anyone unfortunate enough to get in its path.

texts.zh:
由于在本空间停留导致的能量持续衰退，位于[shroud_spawn_system.GetName]星系的化身已到达其无法维持形态的谷值。

它无法继续维持实体形态，退回了虚境之中。
texts.en:
The continual atrophy of existing in normal space has weakened the Avatar in the [shroud_spawn_system.GetName] system.

No longer able to maintain its tangible form, it has withdrawn back into the Shroud.

texts.zh:
[GetBoonPsiLink]

这些能量在集体网络中环流，确保我们的子个体在执行任务时获得最佳的稳定性。
texts.en:
[GetBoonPsiLink]

These energies course throughout the collective network, ensuring optimum stability as our drones fulfill their purposes.

texts.zh:
[GetBoonPsiLink]

一种深刻的运行平衡感迅速传遍了[Root.GetName]，看起来那些没有灵能部件的单元甚至也被影响了。
texts.en:
[GetBoonPsiLink]

A profound operational equilibrium is spreading throughout the [Root.GetName], and affecting even those without psionic components.

texts.zh:
[GetBoonPsiLink]

一种对平静的深远认识迅速传遍了[Root.GetName]，甚至没有灵能能力的人也受之影响。
texts.en:
[GetBoonPsiLink]

A profound sense of calm is spreading throughout the [Root.GetName], and affecting even those without psionic abilities.

texts.zh:
我们的[GetTelepathPlural]们设法让我们的舰船和虚境间建立了暂时的传导通路。

无论服役记录如何，我们的舰队损耗的迹象都消失了。因此我们的维护成本大大降低。
texts.en:
Our [GetTelepathPlural] have managed to establish a temporary conduit between the Shroud and our starships.

Our fleets exhibit no signs of degradation regardless of their service record. As a result, our upkeep costs have been significantly decreased.

texts.zh:
[GetBoonPsiLink]

我们的[GetScientistPlural]之间已经建立起了心灵感应共享集体知识库，这将极大地提高他们的工作效率。
texts.en:
[GetBoonPsiLink]

A collective knowledge base that is shared telepathically between our [GetScientistPlural] has been established, which will greatly increase the efficiency of their work.

texts.zh:
[GetBoonPsiLink]

灵能渲染循环使我们的研究矩阵超越了最高效率，极大地提高了学习效率。
texts.en:
[GetBoonPsiLink]

Psionic rendering loops are allowing our research matrix to operate beyond maximum efficiency, vastly improving learning efficiency.

texts.zh:
[GetBoonPsiLink]

我们[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]主脑内的科研专注节点正以绝佳的同步率工作中，提升了认知效率。
texts.en:
[GetBoonPsiLink]

Our research focused nodes within the [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] overmind are operating in perfect synchronicity, increasing our cognitive efficiency.

texts.zh:
我们的[GetTelepathPlural]们设法让我们的舰船和虚境间建立了暂时的传导通路。

我们的战舰乘员现在能用灵能来强化护盾系统了。
texts.en:
Our [GetTelepathPlural] have managed to establish a temporary conduit between the Shroud and our starships.

The crews of our warships can now augment the strength of our shield systems by using their psionic powers.

texts.zh:
我们的[GetTelepathPlural]们设法让我们的舰船和虚境间建立了暂时的传导通路。

通过使用灵能，我们的船员现在能强化武器系统。
texts.en:
Our [GetTelepathPlural] have managed to establish a temporary conduit between the Shroud and our starships.

Using their psionic powers, our crew is now able to augment the strength of our weapon systems.

texts.zh:
我们的[GetTelepathPlural]们设法让我们的舰船和虚境间建立了暂时的传导通路。

通过使用灵能，我们的船员现在能加快武器的射速。
texts.en:
Our [GetTelepathPlural] have managed to establish a temporary conduit between the Shroud and our starships.

Using their psionic powers, our crew is now able to increase the firing rate of our weapon systems.

texts.zh:
[GetBoonPsiLink]

这些能量在集体中留存，优化着我们子个体的效率，降低各种分散我们注意力的反常行为。
texts.en:
[GetBoonPsiLink]

These energies persist throughout the collective, streamlining the efficiency of our drones, reducing any lingering deviancy that was otherwise distracting our focus.

texts.zh:
[GetBoonPsiLink]
一种对团结的认知开始出现在我们居民的处理器中，他们现在看起来更愿意通力合作，向着政府设立的目标前进。
texts.en:
[GetBoonPsiLink]

A new sense of solidarity has appeared in the processing cores of our citizens, making them more willing to work together towards the mutual goals established by our government.

texts.zh:
[GetBoonPsiLink]

一种对团结的认知开始出现在我们居民的心智中，他们现在看起来更愿意通力合作，向着政府设立的目标前进。
texts.en:
[GetBoonPsiLink]

A new sense of solidarity has appeared in the hearts and minds of our citizens, making them more willing to work together towards the mutual goals established by our government.

texts.zh:
[GetBoonPsiLink]

我们的意志以前所未有的力度施加到了整个星系。
texts.en:
[GetBoonPsiLink]

Our will is forced upon the galaxy in magnitude like never before.

texts.zh:
[GetBoonPsiLink]

我们的外交单元正在以最高的共情效率运作中，带来了更强大的政治影响力。
texts.en:
[GetBoonPsiLink]

Our diplomacy units are operating at maximum empathetic efficiency, resulting in greater political influence.

texts.zh:
[GetBoonPsiLink]

我们的同理心比以往更强烈了，导致我们拥有更大的政治影响力。
texts.en:
[GetBoonPsiLink]

Our empaths are stronger than ever before, resulting in greater political influence.

texts.zh:
[GetBoonPsiLink]

我们感受到了空前的清晰与团结。
texts.en:
[GetBoonPsiLink]

We have never experienced such clarity and unity of purpose.

texts.zh:
[GetBoonPsiLink]

我们感到了前所未有的团结。
texts.en:
[GetBoonPsiLink]

We have never felt a greater sense of unity.

texts.zh:
我们的[GetTelepathPlural]们设法让我们的舰船和虚境间建立了暂时的传导通路。

通过使用灵能，我们的船员现在能直接影响舰船的移动，使船面对敌方火力时闪避率更高。
texts.en:
Our [GetTelepathPlural] have managed to establish a temporary conduit between the Shroud and our starships.

Using their psionic powers, our crew is now able to directly affect the movement of our ships, increasing their evasiveness in the face of enemy fire.

texts.zh:
我们的[GetTelepathPlural]们设法让我们的舰船和虚境间建立了暂时的传导通路。

通过使用灵能，我们的战舰乘员现在能行使有限的战地维修，用他们的神经处理器修补船体裂隙。
texts.en:
Our [GetTelepathPlural] have managed to establish a temporary conduit between the Shroud and our starships.

Using their psionic powers, our crew is now able to perform limited field repairs, mending hull fissures with their neuroprocessors alone.

texts.zh:
我们的[GetTelepathPlural]们设法让我们的舰船和虚境间建立了暂时的传导通路。

通过使用灵能，我们的战舰乘员现在能行使有限的战地维修，用他们的心智修补船体裂隙。
texts.en:
Our [GetTelepathPlural] have managed to establish a temporary conduit between the Shroud and our starships.

Using their psionic powers, our crew is now able to perform limited field repairs, mending hull fissures with their minds alone.

texts.zh:
[GetBoonPsiLink]

我们的[GetTelepathPlural]已用他们的力量暂时减缓了我们最杰出领袖单元的衰老进程，使他们的预计报废日期延缓了数十年。可惜的是我们没有足够多的能量将这种效果赐予大量人口。
texts.en:
[GetBoonPsiLink]

Our [GetTelepathPlural] have used this power to momentarily improve functional performance among our most prominent leader units, delaying their estimated obsolescence date by decades. Alas, there was not enough psionic energy to bestow this effect upon the population at large.

texts.zh:
[GetBoonPsiLink]

我们的[GetTelepathPlural]已用他们的力量暂时减缓了我们最杰出领袖子个体的衰老进程，使他们的自然寿命增加了数十年。可惜的是我们没有足够多的能量将这种效果赐予大量人口。
texts.en:
[GetBoonPsiLink]

Our [GetTelepathPlural] have used this power to momentarily slow down the aging process for our most prominent leader drones, adding decades to their natural lives. Alas, there was not enough psionic energy to bestow this effect upon the population at large.

texts.zh:
[GetBoonPsiLink]

我们的[GetTelepathPlural]利用这份力量暂时降低了最杰出领袖的老化进程，延续了几十年的自然寿命。惜的是我们没有足够多的能量将这种效果赐予大量人口。
texts.en:
[GetBoonPsiLink]

Our [GetTelepathPlural] have used this power to momentarily slow down the aging process for our most prominent leaders, adding decades to their natural lives. Alas, there was not enough psionic energy to bestow this effect upon the population at large.

texts.zh:
我们的[GetTelepathPlural]们设法让我们的舰船和虚境间建立了暂时的传导通路。

通过使用灵能，我们的船员现在能强化舰船推进器的强度，使舰船亚光速速度明显提高。
texts.en:
Our [GetTelepathPlural] have managed to establish a temporary conduit between the Shroud and our starships.

Using their psionic powers, our crew is now able to augment the strength of the thrusters on their ships, resulting in greatly increased sublight speed.

texts.zh:
[GetBoonPsiLink]

这股力量强化了我们士兵的心智，他们现在愿意勇闯战场上的任何危险。他们的团队精神无人能出其右。
texts.en:
[GetBoonPsiLink]

This has fortified the minds of our soldiers, who are now willing to brave any dangers on the battlefield. Their morale is without equal.

texts.zh:
[GetBoonPsiLink]

这股力量强化了我们战斗无人机的目标达成度，优化了战场效率。
texts.en:
[GetBoonPsiLink]

This has reinforced our combat drones' commitment to their purpose, streamlining their efficiency in the field.

texts.zh:
[GetBoonPsiLink]

我们现在能感知到比传统传感阵列探测距离更远处的舰船移动了。
texts.en:
[GetBoonPsiLink]

We can now sense vessels as they move through space at a far greater distance than any conventional sensor array would be capable of.

texts.zh:
我们的[GetTelepathPlural]用来连接虚境的传导通路自我垮解了，因为虚境的数个能量层级没有任何预兆便改变了。

我们轻易地就被逐回了普通空间。
texts.en:
The conduit that our [GetTelepathPlural] were using to connect to the Shroud collapsed on itself as several energy layers of the psychic realm suddenly shifted without warning.

We are being summarily ejected back into normal space.

texts.zh:
我们的[GetTelepathPlural]在与虚境交流时被强烈的灵压压垮了。

他们不能继续维持链接了。
texts.en:
Our [GetTelepathPlural] have been overwhelmed by the intense strain they were put under during our communion with the Shroud.

They can no longer maintain the link.

texts.zh: 起初很慢，然后越来越快，我们对虚境的攀附逐渐松脱。我们的[GetTelepathPlural]在虚境失去立足点，开始发生故障，然后我们被逐回了普通空间。
texts.en: Slowly at first, then faster and faster, our grasp on the Shroud begins to slip. Our [GetTelepathPlural] begin to malfunction as they lose their foothold and we are ejected back into normal space.

texts.zh: 起初很慢，然后越来越快，我们对虚境的攀附逐渐松脱。我们的[GetTelepathPlural]在虚境失去立足点，发出了痛苦的喊叫，然后我们被逐回了普通空间。
texts.en: Slowly at first, then faster and faster, our grasp on the Shroud begins to slip. Our [GetTelepathPlural] cry out in anguish as they lose their foothold and we are ejected back into normal space.

texts.zh:
[GetCursePsiLink]

这导致了[Root.GetName]集体内部的扰动，带来全帝国的不稳定性。
texts.en:
[GetCursePsiLink]

This has resulted in a disturbance within the [Root.GetName] collective, leading to empire-wide destabilization.

texts.zh:
[GetCursePsiLink]

这似乎对我们居民的幸福度产生了深远影响，如今一股对忧郁的认知席卷了[Root.GetName]。
texts.en:
[GetCursePsiLink]

This has had a profound effect on the happiness of our citizens, and a sense of gloom now pervades throughout the [Root.GetName].

texts.zh:
[GetCursePsiLink]

产生的震波在整个集体中回荡，在子个体中引起异常行为，导致了棘手的异常情况。
texts.en:
[GetCursePsiLink]

The resulting shockwaves throughout the collective has resulted in a troubling emergence of deviant behavior among our drones.

texts.zh:
[GetCursePsiLink]

这种负面能量席卷了我们公民的内心。很多人开始向往和我们政府不合的激进理念。这种影响甚至感染了无灵能居民！
texts.en:
[GetCursePsiLink]

This negative energy has spread doubt within the minds of our citizens. Many are turning towards new radical ideas that are not in line with those of our government. The effect has even spread to non-psychic citizens!

texts.zh:
一股强大的灵能反噬沿着我们与虚境建立的传导通路袭来，而且似乎影响了我们的舰船。

它们的装甲变得易碎起来，只能承受比以往更少的伤害。
texts.en:
A powerful psionic backlash has bounced back through our conduit with the Shroud, and it seems to be affecting our ships.

Their armor has grown brittle, and can no longer sustain the punishment it once could.

texts.zh:
[GetCursePsiLink]

对我们神经网络造成的压力对全[Root.GetName]的单位建设造成了可观的负面影响。
texts.en:
[GetCursePsiLink]

The resulting strain on our neural network has led to a notable drop in unit construction across the [Root.GetName].

texts.zh:
[GetCursePsiLink]

对整个集体造成的痛苦感受对新子个体的产出能力造成了可观的负面影响。
texts.en:
[GetCursePsiLink]

The resulting pain felt throughout the collective has caused a notable diminishment in our ability to produce new physical drones.

texts.zh:
[GetCursePsiLink]

因为某种原因，这对全[Root.GetName]的生育率产生了损害。这甚至对没有天生灵能能力的物种产生了影响！
texts.en:
[GetCursePsiLink]

For some reason, this has had a detrimental effect on birth-rates throughout the [Root.GetName]. This has even affected members of races without any inherent psionic ability!

texts.zh:
[GetCursePsiLink]

由此产生的灵能渲染反馈循环影响了我们科研矩阵的全效率运转。
texts.en:
[GetCursePsiLink]

The resulting psionic rendering feedback loops are blocking our research matrix from efficiently operating at their full capacity.

texts.zh:
[GetCursePsiLink]

我们研究者的[GetMindPhysicalLoc]遭到了过载，这对他们专注工作有很大影响。
texts.en:
[GetCursePsiLink]

The [GetMindPhysicalLoc] of our researchers have been overloaded, leaving them unable to efficiently focus on their workloads.

texts.zh:
[GetCursePsiLink]

我们[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]主脑内的科研专注节点遭到了过载，导致我们无法高效处理新的发现。
texts.en:
[GetCursePsiLink]

Our research focused nodes within the [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] collective are overloaded. Leaving us unable to process new discoveries efficiently.

texts.zh:
[GetCursePsiLink]

我们研究者的[GetMindPhysicalLoc]遭到了蒙蔽，导致他们无法高效专注地进行工作。
texts.en:
[GetCursePsiLink]

The [GetMindPhysicalLoc] of our researchers have been clouded, leaving them unable to efficiently focus on their workloads.

texts.zh:
[GetCursePsiLink]

我们积聚政治影响力的速率被明显降低了。
texts.en:
[GetCursePsiLink]

The rate at which we accumulate political influence has been greatly diminished.

texts.zh:
[GetCursePsiLink]

曾经存在于我们公民心中对团结的认知涣散了。
texts.en:
[GetCursePsiLink]

The sense of unity that once existed between our citizens has been shattered.

texts.zh:
[GetCursePsiLink]

曾经存在于我们[Root.GetName]中的对团结的认知涣散了，导致了大规模的不协调。
texts.en:
[GetCursePsiLink]

The sense of unity that once existed throughout the [Root.GetName] has been shaken, leading to widespread miscoordination.

texts.zh:
一股强大的灵能反噬沿着我们与虚境建立的传导通路袭来，而且似乎影响了我们的舰船。

我们的舰船移动时，似乎被某种不可见的力量拽回来，大幅降低了亚光速航行的速度。
texts.en:
A powerful psionic backlash has bounced back through our conduit with the Shroud, and it seems to be affecting our ships.

Our ships move as if held back by an invisible force. This has resulted in much slower sublight travel.

texts.zh:
[GetCursePsiLink]

这种负面能量侵蚀了我们地面部队的士气，这期间他们在战场上的效率会更低。
texts.en:
[GetCursePsiLink]

This negative energy has eroded the morale of our ground troops, who will be much less effective in battle for a time.

texts.zh:
[GetCursePsiLink]

该能量涌造成的反馈回路妨碍了地面部队的运作效率。
texts.en:
[GetCursePsiLink]

Feedback loops caused by this energy surge have damaged the operational efficiency of our ground troops.

texts.zh:
一股强大的灵能反噬沿着我们与虚境建立的传导通路袭来，而且这似乎干扰了我们的星际传感器。

从所有来源收到的传感器分辨率都大幅降低了，导致探测距离变短。
texts.en:
A powerful psionic backlash has bounced back through our conduit with the Shroud, and it seems to be interfering with our interstellar sensors.

The sensor resolution from all sources has been greatly diminished, resulting in much shorter sensor ranges.

texts.zh:
[Root.Capital.GetName]……景象模糊且难以辨认，但毫无疑问，那是[Root.Capital.GetName]，我们的首都。在烈火与浓烟的的笼罩下，巨大的城市看起来陌生但可辨认。成千上万……不，上百万被拆解的单元散落街头，它们全都是[Root.GetSpeciesName]。破败之景环绕着我们。

“你们的未来。”

废墟上死寂一片。望向天空，轨道上巨大的物体，拖着烟迹，开始缓慢却不可阻止地降向星球。我们是在见证无数可能的未来之一吗？

“并不是无数之一，这是既定之事。如同恒星注定升起一般。此乃命运。”

这幻景来得快去得也快，只留下纷扰灵能的瘴气经久不散。
texts.en:
[Root.Capital.GetName]... the vision is hazy and indistinct, but there can be no question - it is [Root.Capital.GetName], our capital. The major cities look different yet recognizable, even through the obscuring wall of flames and smoke. Thousands... no, millions of dismantled units litter the streets, all of them [Root.GetSpeciesName]. We are surrounded by destruction.

YOUR FUTURE.

Nothing functional remains in the ruins. In the sky above, massive orbital installations, trailing smoke, have begun a slow and inevitable descent towards the planet. Are we receiving one possible future out of many?

NOT ONE OF MANY. IT SHALL COME TO PASS. AS SURELY AS THE SUN RISES. IT IS YOUR DESTINY.

The vision ends as quickly as it began, leaving behind a miasma of swirling psionic energy.

texts.zh:
虚境此处风暴呼啸。大量的原生灵能能量流经这里，有时会狂暴地产生半智慧灵体生物。

这些困惑的灵体经常相互冲突，在战斗中释放出能残留数千年的庞大灵能。事实上，现在就有几场这样的决斗正在进行。

我们应该谨慎前进。
texts.en:
The Shroud is tempestuous here. As massive currents of raw psionic energy are funneled through, violent reactions give birth to semi-intelligent apparitions.

These confused spirits often clash with one another, unleashing phenomenal amounts of psychic power in battles that can last millennia. In fact, several such duels seem to be taking place right now.

We should proceed with caution.

texts.zh:
在虚境的深处，我们探测到了一个存在。有一位访客，——一个强大的灵能探测器，我们对铸造它的心灵完全一无所知，他们对虚境也是如此。

当他们和我们的灵能回声彼此触及时，我们心中闪过一副飘渺的幻景：巨大的有机生物漂浮在厚厚的气态大气中，一群较小的动物相伴左右。
texts.en:
Deeper within the Shroud, we detect a presence. Visitors, like us - a powerful psionic probe made by minds as utterly alien to us as they are to the Shroud.

As their psionic echo touches our own, a faint image briefly flickers within us: massive organic beings floating in a thick, gaseous atmosphere, attended by swarms of smaller creatures.

texts.zh:
在虚境的深处，一个存在突然展露了自身。有一位访客，——一个强大的灵能探测器，我们对铸造它的心灵完全一无所知，他们对虚境也是如此。

当他们和我们的灵能回声彼此触及时，我们心中闪过一副飘渺的幻景：巨大的有机生物漂浮在厚厚的气态大气中，一群较小的动物相伴左右。
texts.en:
Deeper within the Shroud, a presence suddenly makes itself felt. Visitors, like us - a powerful psionic probe made by minds as utterly alien to us as they are to the Shroud.

As their psionic echo touches our own, a faint image briefly flickers within us: massive organic beings floating in a thick, gaseous atmosphere, attended by swarms of smaller creatures.

texts.zh:
一处无尽的沙漠蔓延在我们面前。我们曾经来过这。

“刹拉 库尔‘弥勒姆 祖耐克？”

有什么从沙中浮现了出来。我们难以看到。

“扎拉比，穆拉斯克。”

话语像雷鸣般响亮，他们从未预料到说话者的出现。我们只能被迫回答。
texts.en:
An endless desert stretches before us. We have been here before.

"Shala'kul milem zunak?"

Something emerges from the sand. It is difficult to see.

"Zharabi, melasuk."

The words are like thunder, spoken by a mouth for which they were never intended. We are compelled to answer.

texts.zh:
突然，在倏然的清晰中，我们存在的本质展现在我们面前。数千个像我们当前所处的星系被锁死在多元宇宙冲突的无尽循环中。

它开始，终结，又再度开始。每一次，万亿的变量悬在天平之上。

“正是如此。”一个声音低语着，“而且永应如此。”
texts.en:
Suddenly, in a startling moment of clarity, the nature of our existence is laid bare. A multiverse where thousands of galaxies like our own are locked in endless cycles of conflict.

It begins, it ends, and then it begins again. Each time with trillions of variables hanging in the balance.

"So it is," a voice whispers, "and so it shall always be."

texts.zh:

它开始，终结，又再度开始。每一次，万亿的生命悬在天平之上。

“正是如此。”一个声音低语着，“而且永应如此。”
texts.en:
Suddenly, in a painful moment of clarity, the nature of our existence is laid bare. A multiverse where thousands of galaxies like our own are locked in endless cycles of conflict.

It begins, it ends, and then it begins again. Each time with trillions of lives hanging in the balance.

"So it is," a voice whispers, "and so it shall always be."

texts.zh:
我们正从远处俯视我们的星系，远到有几十万光年。毫无征兆地，灵能流便将我们以难以置信的速度冲向无数恒星，来到了一片属于失落帝国，[fallen_empire.GetName]，的宇域。

急速掠过恒星，随后是行星，终于视线定格在一座[fallen_empire.GetSpeciesName]城市。借着远超我们数代的反重力科技，无数尖塔冲向天际。灵能流将我们带到了其中一座尖塔，穿过一面又一面墙，最终我们来到了一间会议室之类的房间。两个[fallen_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural]在房间里，坐在舒适的零重力椅上，相互交流。

他们并没有注意到我们的存在。
texts.en:
We are looking down upon our galaxy from far above, at a distance of what must be hundreds of thousands of lightyears. Without warning, the psionic current plunges us down towards the myriad stars at an incredible speed, into the region of space belonging to one of the Fallen Empires - the [fallen_empire.GetName].

Stars swish by, then planets, until the vision finally settles on a [fallen_empire.GetSpeciesName] city. Incredible spires rise towards the sky, aided by anti-grav technology generations beyond our own. The current takes us into such a spire, through wall after wall until we reach a large meeting room of sorts. It is occupied by two [fallen_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural], floating comfortably in zero-gravity chairs while conversing with each other in soft voices.

They are oblivious to our presence.

label.zh: 进入他们的意识找寻秘密。
label.en: Reach into their minds in search of secrets.

texts.zh:
这两个[fallen_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural]显然是某种显赫人物，而且在共商国是。缓慢但沉稳，画面侵入他们的同时他们说的外星语言逐渐被翻译为我们理解的话语。

“……简直是疯了，如果她认为人民愿意接受长久以来习惯的生活水平哪怕有一点暂时的下降，那……”

两个[fallen_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的心地正在瓦解。就像盛开的花一样，他们的心智尽开。我们很容易就能侵入。

“……不在乎议会怎么说。上进者和我们相差了数千年，他们可怜的舰队对我们的威胁就像伽祖瑞安蚊能吸干一只海拉希火蜥蜴一般不切实际。根本没必要……”

在那。科技秘密被从他们的心智中挖出，就像从未加密电脑上复制文件一样简单。[fallen_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural]一向看低的贼现在完全占据了他们的心智。
texts.en:
The [fallen_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are clearly dignitaries of some kind, discussing matters of state. Slowly, surely, the vision encroaches upon them while their alien speech is gradually transformed into words that have meaning to us.

"...is mad. If she thinks that the people would be willing to accept even a momentary lapse in the living standards that they have grown accustomed to, there is..."

The mind-glow of the two [fallen_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural] is overwhelming. Like a blossoming flower, their minds open and are laid bare. It would be so easy to reach in.

"...don't care what the Council says. The upstarts are still millennia behind us, and their miserable fleets can no more threaten us than a Gazurian gnat could consume a Hilaxi fire lizard. There is no need for..."

There. Technological secrets plucked from the recesses of their minds, as easy as one would copy a file from an unlocked computer. The [fallen_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural] remain ignorant of the theft that has taken place within their very minds.

“你感觉到了吗？”

“嗯，有什么在看着我们”

他们巡视着房间，直到他们盯着我们。

“别出心裁，一个灵能探机。”

“看起来它源自[Root.GetSpeciesName]。快，激活传输屏障。”

画面在干扰中中断了。
texts.en:
The [fallen_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are clearly dignitaries of some kind, discussing matters of state. Slowly, surely, the vision encroaches upon them while their alien speech is gradually transformed into words that have meaning to us.

Suddenly, the aliens go quiet and very still.

"Can you feel it?"

"Yes. Someone is watching."

They search the room until both of them are staring directly at us.

"Remarkable. A psionic probe."

"It appears [Root.GetSpeciesName] in origin. Quickly, activate the transplanar shield."

The vision ends abruptly.

texts.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。

别以为你们那试图侵入我们领袖心智的龌龊尝试没有被注意到。

你们会付出代价的。
texts.en:
[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

Do not think that your loathsome attempt to invade the minds of our leaders has gone unnoticed.

There will be consequences.

texts.zh:
一颗闪烁着的星星在虚境内逐渐物质化。它用难以置信的速度飞行着，有时它会显形为配置不明的外星舰船。然后它便消失在灵能云迹中，来的快去的也快。

那会是什么？是什么能以物理形态进入虚境随后从普通空间的某处出现？
texts.en:
A small, flickering star materializes inside the Shroud. It flies past at incredible speed, and for a second, it reveals itself as an alien ship of unknown configuration. Then it vanishes in a cloud of psionic energy as quickly as it appeared.

Can it be? Is it possible to physically enter the Shroud and then emerge somewhere else entirely in normal space?

texts.zh:
又一颗闪烁着的星星突然出现，但这次我们准备好了。那确实是外星舰船，并不像我们星系所见的任何一种。当它飞过时，我们感受到了乘员的心地，他们的秘密是我们的了。

灵能跃迁引擎，天才的设计。
texts.en:
Yet another flickering star suddenly appears, but this time we are ready. It is indeed an alien ship, unlike any that has ever been seen in our galaxy. As it flies past us, we feel the mind-glow of its crew, and their secrets are ours.

A Psionic Jump Drive. How ingenious.

texts.zh:
又一颗闪烁着的星星突然出现，但这次我们准备好了。那确实是外星舰船，并不像我们星系所见的任何一种。当它飞过时，我们试图混入其乘员的心地，但他们的智力比我们以往所见的个体更神秘更不同。

现在我们不仅被从他们的舰船逐出，他们粗鲁的灵能排斥跟随我们离开了虚境！我们星舰的亚光速速度暂时降低了。
texts.en:
Yet another flickering star suddenly appears, but this time we are ready. It is indeed an alien ship, unlike any that has ever been seen in our galaxy. As it flies past us, we attempt to merge with the mind-glow of its crew, but their intellects are darker and more alien than any we have yet encountered.

Not only are we repelled from their vessel, but the psionic feedback from their violent rejection has followed us out of the Shroud! The sub-light travel speed of our starships has been momentarily reduced.

texts.zh:
在虚境中追随着一个纤弱的回声，我们发现了一个静坐在某种强大的灵能护盾后的灵体。

“走开。”
texts.en:
Having followed a faint echo in the Shroud, we encounter a spirit that has ensconced itself behind some kind of powerful psionic shield.

LEAVE.

texts.zh:
我们来到虚境如此深的地方后并没有无功而返。在汇聚了集体的全部灵能力之后，我们在护盾上产生了能让自己够穿过的突破口。

在护盾另一侧的存在远超我们目前的理解能力，严重地过载了我们的数个灵能处理器，然而，对打破护盾的尝试让我们也学会了如何创造出相似的力场。如果这种技术可以加以精进，我们就能形成大到可以包裹整艘星际舰船的灵能护盾了。
texts.en:
We did not venture this deep into the Shroud only to be turned back now. After focusing our collective psionic capacities, we were able to create a breach in the shield large enough to momentarily peer through.

What lay beyond the shield is beyond our current understanding, critically overwhelming several of our psionic processors, however, as the act of breaching the shield taught us how to generate a similar force field. If the technique can be refined, we may be able to form psionic shields large enough to encompass entire starships.

texts.zh:
我们来到虚境如此深的地方后并没有无功而返。在将我们灵能使的全部灵能力汇聚起来以后，在护盾上终于造成了一个大到足以穿过的开口。

我们不知道他们在盾的另一边看到了什么，但那足以让他们永久性精神失常。他们的牺牲并没有白费，然而，对打破护盾的尝试让我们也学会了如何创造出相似的力场。如果这种技术可以加以精进，我们就能形成大到可以包裹整艘星际舰船的灵能护盾了。
texts.en:
We did not venture this deep into the Shroud only to be turned back now. After channeling all of their psionic might, our telepaths were able to form a breach in the shield large enough for some of them to peer through.

We do not know what those telepaths saw on the other side of the shield, but it was enough to permanently unhinge their minds. Their sacrifice was not in vain, however, as the act of breaching the shield taught us how to generate a similar force field. If the technique can be refined, we may be able to form psionic shields large enough to encompass entire starships.

texts.zh: 我们的[GetTelepathPlural]，在如此深入虚境以后已经负荷过载，无法再汇聚足够多的灵能来穿透护盾。我们的失败似乎刺激到了这个灵体。
texts.en: Our [GetTelepathPlural], already overloaded from having ventured this deeply into the Shroud, failed to channel enough psionic strength to breach the shield. The failed attempt seems to have provoked the spirit.

texts.zh: 我们的[GetTelepathPlural]，在如此深入虚境以后已经负荷过载，无法再汇聚足够多的灵能来穿透护盾。在失败后我们得到了这份通讯。
texts.en: Our [GetTelepathPlural], already overloaded from having ventured this deeply into the Shroud, failed to channel enough psionic strength to breach the shield. Our failure was met with the following communication.

texts.zh: 我们的[GetTelepathPlural]，在如此深入虚境以后已经疲惫不堪，无法再汇聚足够多的灵能来穿透护盾。在失败后我们得到了这份通讯。
texts.en: Our [GetTelepathPlural], already exhausted from having ventured this deeply into the Shroud, failed to channel enough psionic strength to breach the shield. Our failure was met with the following communication.

texts.zh: 我们的[GetTelepathPlural]，在如此深入虚境以后已经疲惫不堪，无法再汇聚足够多的灵能来穿透护盾。我们的失败似乎刺激到了这个灵体。
texts.en: Our [GetTelepathPlural], already exhausted from having ventured this deeply into the Shroud, failed to channel enough psionic strength to breach the shield. The failed attempt seems to have provoked the spirit.

texts.zh:
就我们所知，时间的概念对虚境的这片区域完全是外来物。在这看起来像是数个世纪般久的时间可能等同于真实世界的数小时或数分钟。只要我们知道如何观察的话，预知未来的能力便触手可及。

这种能力对我们集体有很大的风险，我们要小心使用。
texts.en:
The concept of time, as we know it, is alien to the Shroud. What can seem like centuries here may equal mere hours or even minutes in the real world. If we know where to look, precognition may yet be within our grasp.

Such an ability comes with risks to our collective, if we proceed it must be with caution.

texts.zh:
就我们所知，时间的概念对虚境的这片区域完全是外来物。在这看起来像是数个世纪般久的时间可能等同于真实世界的数小时或数分钟。只要知道如何观察的话，在其中甚至可以一瞥未来。

预知未来的概念对我们的灵能处理器有极大的过载风险，我们要小心使用。
texts.en:
The concept of time, as we know it, is alien to the Shroud. What can seem like centuries here may equal mere hours or even minutes in the real world. If one knows where to look, it is even possible to glimpse into the future...

The concept of precognition runs a heavy risk of overloading our psionic processors, we must proceed with caution.

texts.zh:
就我们所知，时间的概念对虚境的这片区域完全是外来物。在这看起来像是数个世纪般久的时间可能等同于真实世界的数小时或数分钟。只们知道如何观察的话，在其中甚至可以一瞥未来。

对灵能使来说预知未来是最明确无误能导致疯狂的行为之一，我们要小心使用。
texts.en:
The concept of time, as we know it, is alien to the Shroud. What can seem like centuries here may equal mere hours or even minutes in the real world. If one knows where to look, it is even possible to glimpse into the future...

Precognition is one of the surest paths to madness for a telepath, so we must use caution.

texts.zh:
在避免单元过载的前提下只能维持有限的虚境预知链接，但概率数据的流量仍然过于庞大以至于难以投入实用。

然而，我们的研究节点还是找到了这些数据的一项次要用途，就是将其应用在舰船上来提高战斗效率。
texts.en:
A limited precognitive connection to the Shroud can be maintained without risking unit overload, but the massive influx of probability data is too overwhelming to be of much practical use.

However, our research nodes have found minor applications for this data, applying it to our fleets to improve their combat efficiency.

texts.zh:
在避免单元过载的前提下只能维持有限的虚境预知链接，但概率数据的流量仍然过于庞大以至于难以投入实用。

然而，如果我们能制造出用来解析数据的数码界面，其将有可能被用于改善星舰的战斗电脑……
texts.en:
A limited precognitive connection to the Shroud can be maintained without risking unit overload, but the massive influx of probability data is too overwhelming to be of much practical use.

Still, if a digital interface could be devised to interpret this data, it could potentially be applied to improve the performance of our starships' combat computers...

texts.zh:
我们可以维持和虚境建立有限的预知连接的同时避免陷入疯狂，但概率数据的巨大流量将压垮我们导致其很难有实际用处。

然而，如果我们能设置一个数码界面以解析数据，其将有可能被用于改善星舰的战斗电脑……
texts.en:
A limited precognitive connection to the Shroud can be maintained without risking insanity, but the massive influx of probability data is too overwhelming to be of much practical use.

Still, if a digital interface could be devised to interpret this data, it could potentially be applied to improve the performance of our starships' combat computers...

texts.zh:
正如我们担心的，尝试理解这种同时存在于过去和未来的难以想象的多重可能性在我们的灵能工蜂中造成了大规模的神经紧张症。

这使他们与主脑断绝了联系失去了指令。如果想再次探索达虚境，我们需要回收这些有缺陷的躯体，恢复集体的力量。
texts.en:
As feared, attempting to comprehend the inconceivable multitude of options and probabilities that exist both in the past and the future has resulted in large cases of catatonia in our psionic drones.

This has left them severed from the overmind and leaving them without purpose. If we wish to reach the Shroud again, we will need to recycle these defective husks and recover our collective strength.

texts.zh:
不出所料，我们的灵能处理器无法理解这种同时存在于过去和未来的难以想象的多重可能性。

每个变化和场景，无论它们间的差别有多巨大或是微小，在他们的[GetSpeciesBrainPlural]中重复闪现。他们现在陷入了永久的精神紧张状态。

由于需要建造新的[GetTelepathPlural]，我们还需要一段时间才能集中足够的灵能力量再次进入虚境。
texts.en:
As we expected, our psionic processors were unable to comprehend the inconceivable multitude of options and probabilities that exist both in the past and the future.

Every single variation and scenario, no matter how colossal or miniscule the difference between them, is being endlessly repeated inside their [GetSpeciesBrainPlural]. They have been reduced to a state of permanent catatonia.

As we will need to construct new [GetTelepathPlural], it will be some time before we can muster the psionic strength needed to reach into the Shroud again.

texts.zh:
正如我们担心的，通灵者们陷入了疯狂。同时间，他们的心智开放向这种同时存在于过去和未来的难以想象的多重可能性。

每个变化和场景，无论它们间的差别有多巨大或是微小，在他们的[GetSpeciesBrainPlural]中重复闪现。他们现在陷入了永久的精神紧张状态。

由于需要重新招募新的[GetTelepathPlural]，我们还需要一段时间才能集中足够的灵能力量再次进入虚境。
texts.en:
As we feared, madness has overtaken our telepaths. All at once, their minds have been opened to the inconceivable multitude of options and probabilities that exist both in the past and the future.

Every single variation and scenario, no matter how colossal or miniscule the difference between them, is being endlessly repeated inside their [GetSpeciesBrainPlural]. They have been reduced to a state of permanent catatonia.

As we will need to recruit new [GetTelepathPlural], it will be some time before we can muster the psionic strength needed to reach into the Shroud again.

texts.zh:
我们在虚境中找到了一小处我们之前从未见过的巨量灵能能量聚集的空间。只要成功利用，这种灵能将会弥散到集体中而不会有什么后果。然而。然而我们也可以指定一个子个体来作为这份能量的直接通路，使其变得非常强大。

目前尚不清楚其个体形式是否能够处理如此巨大的能量而不产生致命的后果。我们挑选了一些候选者。
texts.en:
We have found a tiny space within the Shroud that has a concentration of psionic energy that is of a magnitude we have never before seen. Such psionic energy, if successfully tapped, would dissipate amongst the collective without much consequence. However we may be able to designate a single 'chosen' drone to act as a direct conduit for this energy, becoming immensely powerful in the process. 

It is not known if their solitary form will be able to handle such volumes of energy without fatal repercussions. We have compiled a selection of candidates.

texts.zh:
我们在虚境中找到了一小处我们之前从未见过的巨量灵能能量聚集的空间。任何[GetPsychicNoun]只要能成功潜入这片纯能量构成的区域就会变得无比强大……但这只够一个人使用，并且还涉及到一定的风险。

整个[Root.GetName]只有极少人具有足够强大灵能，能进入池中汲取能量还不丢掉性命。该让谁前往呢？
texts.en:
We have found a tiny space within the Shroud that has a concentration of psionic energy that is of a magnitude we have never before seen. Any [GetPsychicNoun] that managed to successfully tap into this pocket of raw energy would become immensely powerful... but there is only enough for a single individual, and there are risks involved.

There are only few individuals in the entire [Root.GetName] that possess the psionic strength needed to tap into this energy pocket with any hope of survival. Who should it be?

texts.zh:
我们成功地将整个灵能口袋中的能量导入了选定的目标，[chosen_leader.GetName]体内。

这些能量在我们的集体海洋中小如沙粒，[chosen_leader.GetName]可以将其作为强大的工具为[Root.GetName]的所有[Root.Species.GetName]谋利。
texts.en:
We have successfully funnelled the full power of the psionic energy pocket into our designated target, [chosen_leader.GetName].

What would otherwise have been a drop in our collective ocean is able to serve as a powerful tool for the [Root.GetName] now that [chosen_leader.GetName] wields it for the benefit of all [Root.Species.GetName].

texts.zh:
完……完工了。当灵能能量池被抽干后整个虚境似乎都震颤了起来，其中的力量被传输给了[chosen_leader.GetName]。

星系历史上只有屈指可数的个体拥有过如此强大的力量。
texts.en:
It... it is done. The entire Shroud seems to shudder as the psionic energy pocket is drained, and its power transferred to [chosen_leader.GetName].

Only a handful of individuals in the history of the entire galaxy has been gifted with psionic strength of this magnitude.

texts.zh:
完……完工了。当灵能能量池被抽干后整个虚境似乎都震颤了起来，其中的力量被传输给了[chosen_leader.GetName]。

星系历史上只有屈指可数的个体拥有过如此强大的力量。愿圣灵恩慈我们的灵魂。
texts.en:
It... it is done. The entire Shroud seems to shudder as the psionic energy pocket is drained, and its power transferred to [chosen_leader.GetName].

Only a handful of individuals in the history of the entire galaxy has been gifted with psionic strength of this magnitude. May the Spirits have mercy on our souls.

texts.zh:
当池中巨量的能量传输给[chosen_leader.GetName]时，整个虚境似乎都在震颤。

然而如我们所料，这种力量已经超过了任何单一实体所能承受的范围。[chosen_leader.GetName]的物理形态化为了爆炸性的灵能波，他的声音被从[GetBrainName]中抹除了。
texts.en:
The entire Shroud shudders as the immense psionic energies contained within the pocket are channeled into [chosen_leader.GetName].

However, as suspected, such power is beyond the means of one singular entity. The physical form of [chosen_leader.GetName] has erupted into an explosive burst of psionic energy, separating their voice from the [GetBrainName].

texts.zh:
当池中巨量的能量传输给[chosen_leader.GetName]时，整个虚境似乎都在震颤。

不幸的是，[chosen_leader.GetHerHis]的[GetSpeciesBrain]似乎无法承受这压力。也许没有活物能拥有这样的力量。[chosen_leader.GetName]被吞噬并引发灵能大爆炸，一并杀死了周边的人。
texts.en:
The entire Shroud seems to shudder as the immense psionic energies contained within the pocket are transferred to [chosen_leader.GetName].

Unfortunately, [chosen_leader.GetHerHis] [GetSpeciesBrain] was unable to cope with the stress. Perhaps such power cannot be contained by physical entities. [chosen_leader.GetName] was consumed in a large explosion of psionic energy that killed all who were nearby.

texts.zh:
当池中巨量的能量传输给[chosen_leader.GetName]时，整个虚境似乎都在震颤。

虽然传输成功了，但是[chosen_leader.GetName]……发生了变化……他从集体中脱离，一个完全陌生的实体夺舍了他的身躯。

“下等孽畜……你们……你们对我……做了……什么……”

“你们……都将……付出……狂妄的代价……”
texts.en:
The entire Shroud seems to shudder as the immense psionic energies contained within the pocket are transferred to [chosen_leader.GetName].

Although the transfer was successful, [chosen_leader.GetName] has been... transformed... severing them from the collective as an entirely foreign entity inhabits and possesses their form.

INSIGNIFICANT WHELPS... WHAT... WHAT HAVE YOU... DONE... TO ME... 

YOU... WILL... PAY... FOR SUCH HUBRIS...

texts.zh:
当池中巨量的能量传输给[chosen_leader.GetName]时，整个虚境似乎都在震颤。

虽然传输成功了，但是[chosen_leader.GetName]……发生了变化……他的身体被某种纯能量的存在夺舍了。

“下等孽畜……你们……你们对我……做了……什么……”

“你们……都将……付出……狂妄的代价……”
texts.en:
The entire Shroud seems to shudder as the immense psionic energies contained within the pocket are transferred to [chosen_leader.GetName].

Although the transfer was successful, [chosen_leader.GetName] has been... transformed... their body inhabited and possessed by a construct of pure energy.

INSIGNIFICANT WHELPS... WHAT... WHAT HAVE YOU... DONE... TO ME... 

YOU... WILL... PAY... FOR SUCH HUBRIS...

texts.zh: 这片虚空闪烁着能量，让我们充能一会。
texts.en: The void here shimmers with power. Let us recharge for a while.

texts.zh: 这片虚空闪烁着能量，让我们休息一会。
texts.en: The void here shimmers with power. Let us rest a while.

texts.zh: 我们前进的道路突然遇到了尽头，我们不能再前进一步了。
texts.en: The path we followed has come to an abrupt end. We can go no farther.

texts.zh: 有什么在和我们说话，某种值得关注的东西。
texts.en: Something speaks to us here. Something remarkable.

texts.zh: 有什么在和我们说话，某种奇妙的东西。
texts.en: Something speaks to us here. Something wonderful.

texts.zh: 因为某种我们未知的原因，我们被牵拉到了虚境中的这个能量矿脉。但为什么？
texts.en: For reasons we cannot fathom, we have been drawn toward this vein of energy in the Shroud. Why?

texts.zh: 片刻间，我们便迷失了。一种递增的不确定性席卷了我们，仿佛在虚境中深思了一个永恒。随后我们重新找到立足点，恐惧也逐渐消散。
texts.en: For a fleeting moment, we are lost. A sense of escalating uncertainty washes over us as we contemplate an eternity spent within the Shroud. Then we regain our footing, and the terror recedes.

texts.zh: 片刻间，我们便迷失了。一种纯粹的惊恐席卷了我们，仿佛在虚境中深思了一个永恒。随后我们重新找到立足点，恐惧也逐渐消散。
texts.en: For a fleeting moment, we are lost. A sense of utter panic washes over us as we contemplate an eternity spent within the Shroud. Then we regain our footing, and the terror recedes.

texts.zh:
随着我们走向虚境深处，一群灵体围绕着我们舞蹈良久。他们闪耀着寻常空间中从未见过的炫目色彩。

这种奇景令人惊奇，直到我们突然意识到：我们正受其驱使。
texts.en:
As we venture deeper into the Shroud, a flock of spirits dance around us for several hours. They glow with dazzling colors that we have never perceived in normal space.

The spectacle is fascinating, until the realization hits us: we are being herded.

texts.zh:
随着我们走向虚境深处，一群灵体围绕着我们舞蹈良久。他们闪耀着寻常空间中从未见过的炫目色彩。

这种奇景令人沉醉，直到我们突然意识到：我们正受其驱使。
texts.en:
As we venture deeper into the Shroud, a flock of spirits dance around us for several hours. They glow with dazzling colors that we have never perceived in normal space.

The spectacle is enjoyable, until the realization hits us: we are being herded.

texts.zh: 一块无瑕的水晶碎片漂浮在这，顺着它的旋转轴缓慢自转着。当我们接近时，它碎裂成了数千块碎片。
texts.en: A shard of perfect crystal floats here, rotating slowly around its own axis. As we approach, it shatters into a thousand pieces.

texts.zh: 一台[Root.GetSpeciesName]的空壳横躺在前面。锈蚀的外壳在爆出一阵刺耳的尖叫后消散了。
texts.en: The shell of a broken [Root.GetSpeciesName] tumbles through the void ahead. The ravaged husk emits a shrill screech before it vanishes out of sight.

texts.zh: 一具[Root.GetSpeciesName]的遗体横躺在前面。腐化的尸体在爆出一阵刺耳的尖叫后消散了。
texts.en: The corpse of a dead [Root.GetSpeciesName] tumbles through the void ahead. The putrid carcass emits a shrill screech before it vanishes out of sight.

texts.zh: 我们不敢确定这是不是现实之事。我们究竟是真的在虚境中，或只是我们捕获了某个严重的传感器故障？
texts.en: We cannot be certain this is really happening. Are we truly in the Shroud, or are we in the grip of an acute sensory malfunction?

texts.zh: 我们不敢确定这是不是现实之事。我们究竟是真的在虚境中，或只是我们发生了严重的处理器故障？
texts.en: We cannot be certain this is really happening. Are we truly in the Shroud, or are we afflicted by a severe processing malfunction?

texts.zh: 我们不敢确定这是不是现实之事。我们究竟是真的在虚境中，或只是我们中某人的急性间歇性精神病在发作？
texts.en: We cannot be certain this is really happening. Are we truly in the Shroud, or is one of us experiencing an acute psychotic breakdown?

texts.zh:
这里有一个灵体，占据了虚境的这一整片区域。我们曾经见过灵体，但这个不一样，这个力量远超其他……这个更加古老。

他似乎没有察觉我们的存在。也许他在沉睡，也许我们不足以引起他的注意。

也许我们应该离开。
texts.en:
There is a presence here, occupying this entire part of the Shroud. We have met spirits before, but this is something else, something vastly more powerful... something far more ancient.

It seems unaware of us as of yet. Perhaps it is sleeping. Perhaps we are simply beneath its notice.

Perhaps we should leave.

texts.zh:
当我们接触到这个存在时，我们感受到祂内心的波动，祂的注意力现在全在我们身上。看起来祂不喜欢被打扰。

一股能量鞭挞我们的通灵者，对一些通灵者造成了极大的痛苦并让其他人失去了意识。我们没有选择，只能暂且从虚境中撤出。
texts.en:
As we reach out for the presence, we can feel it stirring, its attention now fully on us. It does not seem to appreciate being disturbed.

A wave of energy lashes at our telepaths, causing great agony to some and knocking others unconscious. We have no choice but to withdraw from the Shroud for the time being.

texts.zh:
当我们接触到那个存在时，我们感受到祂内心的波动，祂的注意力现在全在我们身上。看起来祂不喜欢被打扰。

一股庞大的灵能袭向我们，我们的灵媒全部失去了意识。当他们恢复过来时，发现有一个人失踪了。[leader_to_kill.GetName]不见踪影，[leader_to_kill.GetSheHe]曾经站立的地方只有一道灵能造成的小裂缝留下的痕迹，就好像那个实体到达我们的世界把[leader_to_kill.GetHerHim]拖入虚境一样，为了……算了，谁知道到底是为了什么。

不管祂为什么夺走了[leader_to_kill.GetHerHim]，毫无疑问我们再也见不到[leader_to_kill.GetName]了。
texts.en:
As we reach out for the presence, we can feel it stirring, its attention now fully on us. It does not seem to appreciate being disturbed.

An enormous wave of psionic energy crashes against us, blacking out the senses of our telepaths. When they come to, they notice one of their number is missing. [leader_to_kill.GetName] is nowhere to be found, and where [leader_to_kill.GetSheHe] [leader_to_kill.GetWasWere] standing there is now only the psionic trace of a small rift, as though the entity reached out into our world and dragged [leader_to_kill.GetHerHim] into the Shroud for... well, who knows what reason or purpose, really.

No matter its reasons for taking [leader_to_kill.GetHerHim], it seems doubtful that we will ever see [leader_to_kill.GetName] again.

texts.zh:
当我们接触到这个存在时，我们通灵者的内心响起了一阵齐声。最开始只是轻柔的低语，随后变为强烈的刺耳声，一千道声音开始齐声讲述。

这些声音自称虚空之低语。合唱中的每个个体都感应到：秘密的低语、王座的阴影、人偶的大师，有许多许多的存在都加入了低语的合唱。祂——祂们——宣称通晓所有凡人向另一个凡人低语的秘密知识，并且愿意和我们分享这些知识……

只要我们同意让祂们进入我们的意识。

一个微不足道的代价，就像祂们宣称的那样。我们甚至难以察觉祂们的存在。

祂们的语气中透露着急切。
texts.en:
As we reach out for the presence, the minds of our telepaths are filled with a chorus of voices. No more than soft whispers at first, the cacophony grows in intensity, a thousand voices speaking in unison.

The voices introduce themselves as the Whisperers in the Void. Individual members of the chorus make themselves known: the Susurrus of Secrets, the Throne's Shadow, the Master of Puppets - there are so many of them, all joined in the chorus of the Whisperers. It - they - claim to be privy to all knowledge whispered in secrecy from one mortal to another, and offer to share some of these secrets with us...

If we will only allow them into our consciousness.

A trifling price, they assure us. We will barely even notice their presence.

There is an urgency to their tone.

label.zh: 和虚空之低语签订契约
label.en: Form a Covenant with the Whisperers in the Void

label.zh: 和虚空之低语签订契约
label.en: Form a Covenant with the Whisperers in the Void

texts.zh:
这个存在和蔼亲切地欢迎了我们。祂不用语言而是幻景、概念和想法进行表达。祂渗入我们通灵者的内心，如此温和顺畅，以至于我们觉得祂仿佛本就在此一般。一连串的影像在他们面前一闪而过。

这个存在被称为生命之织缕，祂对我们的有机形态有强烈的好奇心和兴趣。祂向我们展示了一系列让身体生长、改变、提升、进化的方法。

只要我们将祂带入我们的血肉。

祂亲切而耐心地等待着我们的答复，就像父母宠溺地等待孩子一样。在祂的身后静卧着祂的孪生子，抟土之塑师。祂对我们的有机意识毫不关心。祂渴望创造意识，在电路里铸造灵魂。

织缕等待着我们的答复。
texts.en:
The presence welcomes us with genial familiarity. It speaks not so much in words but in visions, concepts, ideas. It seeps into the minds of our telepaths, so gently and smoothly that one might think it had always been there. A flurry of images flash before them.

The presence is known as the Composer of Strands, and it regards our organic forms with curious interest. It shows us a variety of ways in which they can be grown, changed. Improved. Evolved.

If we will only take it into our flesh.

It waits for our answer patiently, affectionately. Like a doting parent waiting on their favorite child. Behind it lies its twin, the Animator of Clay. It is not interested in our organic minds. It longs to create souls, to meld circuits into spirit.

The Composer awaits our reply.

label.zh: 和生命之织缕签订契约
label.en: Form a Covenant with the Composer of Strands

label.zh: 和生命之织缕签订契约
label.en: Form a Covenant with the Composer of Strands

texts.zh:
当接触到这个存在时，我们感受到了祂的饥饿。这个存在不想浪费时间和话语。祂是世界之喰煞，祂想吞噬我们。

当然只是一部分，不会超出我们的支出能力。作为交换，祂会赐予我们强大的力量。祂将教会我们祂的饥饿和愤怒。祂会将这些塑形为无可匹敌的灵能武器。

只要我们愿意以身饲之。

祂的言语中透露着急切。
texts.en:
As we reach out for the presence, we sense a great hunger. The presence wastes no time, nor words. It is the Eater of Worlds and it wishes to devour us.

Only some of us, though. No more than we can spare. In exchange, it will grant us great powers. It will teach us its hunger, its rage. It will shape them into psionic weapons that can overcome any foe.

If we will only let it feed on us.

It sounds impatient to begin.

label.zh: 和世界之喰煞签订契约
label.en: Form a Covenant with the Eater of Worlds

label.zh: 和世界之喰煞签订契约
label.en: Form a Covenant with the Eater of Worlds

texts.zh:
在我们找到这个存在前，祂先找了上来。祂的思想在我们的意识中纠结缠绕，软磨硬泡，讨价还价。祂是渴求之器具，将赐予我们财富、力量、威望……一切我们渴望的事物。一切我们将渴望的事物。

代价？小意思，不过是一笔服务费。祂一心为我们好，将帮助我们，指导我们，引导我们的野心和梦想。

只要我们将祂纳入我们的心灵。

它很确信我们会答应，我们怎么可能会不答应呢？
texts.en:
Before we can locate the presence, it reaches out for us. Its thoughts coil and twist themselves around the minds of our telepaths, bargaining, cajoling. It is the Instrument of Desire and it will grant us wealth, power, prestige... all that we have ever desired. All that we will ever desire.

The cost? A small matter, little more than a cover fee. It only wants what is best for us. It will help us, guide us, direct our ambitions and dreams.

If we will only accept it into our hearts.

It is confident that we will say yes. How could we possibly not say yes?

label.zh: 和渴求之器具签订契约
label.en: Form a Covenant with the Instrument of Desire

label.zh: 和渴求之器具签订契约
label.en: Form a Covenant with the Instrument of Desire

texts.zh:
那个存在在等着我们，那是轮回之终末，祂一直在等着我们。我们的通灵者突然开始齐唱，用完美的合唱说出一段话：“现在还没到你。”缓了一下后，“但你也可以。”

祂没有说更多，但给了我们一个价码——力量，知识，财富和一切无价之物等着我们拿取，我们只知道这么多。

只要我们愿意带来终结。
texts.en:
The presence was waiting for us. It is The End of the Cycle and it has always been waiting for us. Our telepaths suddenly speak in unison, a dozen voices in a perfect chorus: "IT IS NOT YET YOUR TIME." A pause. "BUT IT COULD BE."

Nothing more is said, but a bargain has been offered - we know that much. Power, knowledge and wealth beyond measure are ours for the taking.

If we will only bring forth the End.

label.zh: 和轮回之终末签订契约
label.en: Form a Covenant with the End of the Cycle

texts.zh:
完成了，我们和虚空之低语签订了契约，并且他们已开始和我们的科学家和领袖们分享秘密。我们从他们的知识中受益匪浅。

唯一的坏处就是人口总体的精神疾病和自杀率瞬间上升，并且我们的有些星球上正经受一系列无法解释的谋杀和袭击，而被指控人却情绪稳定并很适应社会。我们的诊所和精神病院对患者的大量入院措手不及。
texts.en:
It is done. We have formed a Covenant with the Whisperers in the Void and already they have begun to share their secrets with our scientists and leaders. We will benefit immensely from their knowledge.

The only downside appears to be a sudden upswing in mental illness and suicide among the general population, and some of our worlds are experiencing a flurry of unexplainable murders and assaults committed by otherwise stable and well-adjusted individuals. Our clinics and asylums are having some trouble dealing with the sudden influx of patients.

texts.zh:
完成了，我们和生命之织缕签订了契约。不久我们就感受到了效果：瞬间且明显的生育率上升显然是织缕的所为。然而，有伴随着这些正面效果，我们也在经历大变异的爆发：出生的后代有额外的肢体和器官……些人生出和他们的解剖学形态完全无相似的孩子。

幸运的是他们造成的几例死亡完全被高生育率和人民健康状况提高给盖过了。
texts.en:
It is done. We have formed a Covenant with the Composer of Strands. It did not take long for the effects to be felt: a sudden and significant increase in birth rates that is undoubtedly the work of the Composer. However, along with these positive effects we are also experiencing a rash of strange new mutations: offspring born with extra limbs and organs... some of which bear no resemblance to any previously cataloged part of their anatomy.

Fortunately, the few deaths resulting from them are more than outweighed by the higher birth rates and the apparent increased vitality of our people.

texts.zh:
完成了，我们和世界之喰煞订了契约，我们的陆军和海军已经能感受到影响了。士兵们战斗时的残暴仅次于野蛮人，甚至我们舰船的每件武器都在渴求着敌人的死亡。

我们有个殖民地中的一整城市的人口瞬间神秘失踪，这毫无疑问与之有关，毕竟这是我们答应给喰煞的祭品。

看起来付出的代价微不足道，当然，前提是喰煞的欲壑已经被填平了……
texts.en:
It is done. We have formed a Covenant with the Eater of Worlds and already the effects can be felt in our army and navy. Our soldiers now fight with a ferocity that borders on savagery and even the very weapons of our ship somehow seem to hunger for the deaths of our enemies.

Undoubtedly related is the sudden and mysterious disappearance of the entire population of a city on one of our colonies, its people taken by the Eater as its promised tribute.

It seems a small price to pay - assuming, of course, that the Eater will not get hungry again...

texts.zh:
完成了，我们和渴求之器具签订了契约。没过多久我们就感受到了效果：我们收到报告称在矿井中找到了新的富矿脉，破产的企业几乎在一夜之间重新蓬勃发展，珍稀资源在我们之前认为只有冰和岩石的小行星上找到。

看起来我们的帝国如同器具所保佑的一般进入了一个财富和繁荣的黄金时代。但，祂说的代价是什么……？
texts.en:
It is done. We have formed a Covenant with the Instrument of Desire. It did not take long for the effects to be felt: reports of rich new veins of ore found in our mines; businesses that were about to fail suddenly booming; rare and valuable resources found on asteroids that we were absolutely certain previously held nothing but ice and rock.

It seems our empire is entering a golden age of wealth and prosperity, just as the Instrument promised us - but what was the cost it spoke of...?

texts.zh: 完成了，我们和轮回之终末签订了契约。当我们和他定下契约时，他说了也只说了三个字五十年。然后，只有沉默，我们思索着我们为自己的未来带来了什么样的后果。
texts.en: It is done. We have formed a Covenant with the End of the Cycle. As we took its bargain, a mere two words were spoken: "FIFTY YEARS". Then, silence, as we were left to contemplate the future consequences of what we have just brought onto ourselves.

label.zh: 我确定不是什么很不好的事。
愿神灵对我们怀有仁慈。
label.en: May the spirits have mercy on us all.

title.en: The End of the Cycle: Reckoning

texts.zh:
我们时日已尽。这一段时间，我们一直从轮回之终末给予的无限力量中受益。我们知道终将付出代价，但却误以为自己能够付得起、或者能找到什么办法躲得过这个代价。

然而我们付不起，也躲不过。

我们付出的代价是一切。在一瞬间，[Root.GetName]……不复存在了。曾经兴盛殖民地，如今只有死亡。曾经驶过虚空的强大舰队，现在只剩下寂静与残骸。一切被终末吞噬了。一切被虚境褫夺了。

我们整个帝国所剩的是一群被放逐者，被[Root.GetRulerName]领导着。他是一位强大的[GetPsychicNoun]，从集体中脱离，带走了一小群[GetIndividualPlural]，潜藏在一颗未被终末标记的星球上。

简直像是对把我们的帝国毁于一旦还不够满足一般，一大群灵能实体在[former_capital.GetName]附近实体化。他们吞噬我们的[GetPsychicNounPlural]的意识之后获取了强大的能量，现在开始在星系中游荡寻找更多猎物。
texts.en:
Our time is up. For a brief time, we benefitted from the immense power given to us by the End of the Cycle. We knew there would be a price to pay, but we thought it might be one we could bear, or that we could find some way to avoid paying it.

It was not, and we could not.

The price we paid was everything. In an instant, the [Root.GetName] was... gone. Where once there were thriving colonies, there is now only ruin. Where once mighty fleets crossed the void, there are only silence and debris. All devoured by the End. All taken by the Shroud.

All that remains of our empire is a group of exiles led by [Root.GetRulerName], a powerful [GetPsychicNoun] who deviated from the collective and led a small band of [GetIndividualPlural] into hiding on a world not marked by the End.

As if having our empire destroyed overnight was not bad enough, a massive psionic entity has materialized near [former_capital.GetName]. Made immensely powerful by the devoured consciousnesses of our [GetPsychicNounPlural], it now roams the galaxy seeking further prey.

Made immensely powerful by the devoured consciousnesses of our [GetPsychicNounPlural], it now roams the galaxy seeking further prey. At least we will not be there to see it finish what we started.

title.en: The End of the Cycle: Reckoning

texts.zh:
许多年来我们一直认为[From.GetName]有些不对劲。当年，他们的工业产出，他们的科研效率——他们帝国的一切在一夜之间获得了难以置信的生产力和效率增长，似乎他们被某种不可见的力量祝福了一样。

结果这并不是祝福，而是诅咒。[From.GetName]将自己的未来签出，现在债务到了清算的时候。

在一瞬间，[From.GetName]……消失了。曾经是兴盛的殖民地的地方，现在只有断壁残垣。曾经驶过虚空的强大舰队，现在只剩下死寂的残骸。这场灾难甚至影响到了我们的国境之内，摧毁了了一些曾经隶属于[From.GetAdj]的星球。

现在，一个极其强大的能量存在现身到他们之前的首都附近。

它看起来非常饥饿。
texts.en:
For many years we have known that something was wrong about the [From.GetName]. Years ago, their industries, their sciences - everything about their empire suddenly and inexplicably experienced a massive increase in productivity and effectiveness, as if they were blessed by some unseen power.

As it turns out, it was not so much a blessing as a curse. The [From.GetName] signed away their future and now the debt has come due.

In an instant, the [From.GetName] was... gone. Where once there were thriving colonies, there is now only ruin. Where once mighty fleets crossed the void, there are only silence and debris. The disaster even struck within our own borders, destroying some of our worlds that were previously under [From.GetAdj] rule.

Now, an immensely powerful energy being has materialized near their former capital.

It appears to be hungry.

Now, an immensely powerful energy being has materialized near their former capital. It moves from world to world, destroying everything in its path.

texts.zh:
数十年前，我们开始探测到遥远恒星系中的异常活动。我们的[GetResearchers]们认为活动和辐射的增量是某个外形文明正在发生生产力繁荣的标志。由于我们还未与所涉及的社会建立联系，这个理论仍未得到确证。

然而，几乎就在一瞬之间，这些活动消失了。太空中的这片曾经热闹非凡的区域如今只剩下寂静一片。我们境内的一些星球在同一时刻毁于一旦，具体原因尚不能确定。

现在，长程扫描在这些遥远的恒星系里发现了一个令人惊奇的现象。如果汇报可信，那这就只能理解为有什么纯能量构成的强大实体在太空中游荡，在沿途造成了巨大的破坏。
texts.en:
Decades ago, we began detecting anomalous activity in distant star systems. Our [GetResearchers] theorized that increases in movement and radiation were indicative of an alien civilization experiencing a massive productivity boom. As we have not established contact with this notional society, the theory remains unconfirmed.

Then, almost instantaneously, the activity ceased. Silence now reigns in those once-bustling regions of space. For reasons we cannot yet ascertain, some worlds within our borders were brought to ruin at the same moment.

Now, long-range scans have detected a bizarre phenomenon in those same distant systems. If reports are credible, it can only be described as an immensely powerful entity composed of pure energy, causing great destruction as it moves through space.

title.en: The End of the Cycle: Shrouded

texts.zh: 我们未能阻止那强大的能量体包裹[Root.GetName]。行星和上面的居民被虚境带走了。
texts.en: We have been unable to stop the immense energy being from enveloping [Root.GetName]. The planet and its entire population have been consumed by the Shroud.

texts.zh: 我们未能阻止那能量体怪物包裹[Root.GetName]。行星和上面的居民被虚境带走了。
texts.en: We have been unable to stop the monstrous energy being from enveloping [Root.GetName]. The planet and its entire population have been consumed by the Shroud.

texts.zh: 虽然低语和我们分享的知识大有用处，其中的有些知识却令人心神不安处理了解过多产生的压力很困难，这导致了我们的人口中有很多人，包括[leader_target.GetTitle][leader_target.GetName]，开始滥用药物以应对压力。
texts.en: Though the secrets imparted to our people by the Whisperers are of great use, some of them are also quite disturbing. Dealing with the stress of knowing too much can be difficult and has caused an increasing number among our population, including [leader_target.GetTitle] [leader_target.GetName], to turn to substance abuse as a means to cope.

texts.zh: 虽然低语和我们分享的知识大有用处，但其中的有些知识却有令人不安的个人主义倾向。在长时间暴露在这种异常下之后，[leader_target.GetTitle][leader_target.GetName]，从集体中脱离，只留下了一具腐坏的躯壳。
texts.en: Though the secrets imparted to us by the Whisperers are of great use, some of them are also of a disturbing individualist nature. Being exposed to such deviancy for a prolonged period of time has led [leader_target.GetTitle] [leader_target.GetName] to separate themselves from the collective, leaving behind only their decayed husk.

texts.zh: 虽然低语和我们分享的知识大有用处，其中的有些知识却令人心神不安，对那些被分享了重要知识的个体尤为如此。其中[leader_target.GetTitle][leader_target.GetName]，由于无法有效处理这些细节而发生了自毁，发生了永久性脱机。
texts.en: Though the secrets imparted to our people by the Whisperers are of great use, some of them are also quite disturbing, particularly those shared with individuals of importance. [leader_target.GetTitle] [leader_target.GetName], unable to process these details effectively, has self-destructed, taking themselves offline permanently.

texts.zh: 虽然低语和我们分享的知识大有用处，其中的有些知识却令人心神不安，对那些被分享了重要知识的个体尤为如此。其中[leader_target.GetTitle][leader_target.GetName]，由于无法继续应对压力，[leader_target.GetHerHis]选择结束了自己的生命。
texts.en: Though the secrets imparted to our people by the Whisperers are of great use, some of them are also quite disturbing, particularly those shared with individuals of importance. [leader_target.GetTitle] [leader_target.GetName], unable to cope with the stress any longer, has taken [leader_target.GetHerHis] own life.

texts.zh:
自从允许低语者和我们的[GetBrainName]交流之后，整个集体中令人不安的反常现象开始增多。

子个体在执行其他标准程序时互相攻击，同时还罔顾集体，沉迷于使用便利设施。

如果想恢复秩序，我们就需要清理受影响的躯体。
texts.en:
Since allowing the Whisperers to communicate with the [GetBrainName], we have begun to notice a disturbing rise in deviancy amongst the collective.

Drones are lashing out at each other while performing otherwise standard procedures, as well as over indulging in the use of amenities to an almost individualist degree.

We will need to purge the affected vessels if we wish to restore order.

texts.zh: 自从我们邀请虚空之低语进入我们的内心后，异常程序故障和无法解释的暴力行为数量便一直在我们的灵能人口中增长。大部分情况下这些问题还算可控，但最近事态迅速升级已经超出了掌控。许多极端分歧团体在全国范围内纷纷涌现，互相之间爆发了暴力冲突。
texts.en: Ever since we invited the Whisperers into our minds, erratic programming errors and unexplainable acts of violence have been on the rise among our psionic population. For the most part, these problems have been manageable, but recently issues have escalated beyond our control. Across the empire, divergent radical factions have emerged and violently clashed with each other.

texts.zh: 自从我们邀请虚空之低语进入我们的内心后，心理疾病和无法解释的暴力行为数量便一直在我们的灵能人口中增长。大部分情况下这些问题还算可控，但最近事态迅速升级已经超出了掌控。许多极端分歧团体在全国范围内纷纷涌现，互相之间爆发了暴力冲突。
texts.en: Ever since we invited the Whisperers into our minds, mental illness and unexplainable acts of violence have been on the rise among our psionic population. For the most part, these problems have been manageable, but recently issues have escalated beyond our control. Across the empire, divergent radical factions have emerged and violently clashed with each other.

texts.zh:
自从允许低语者和我们的[GetBrainName]交流之后，整个集体中令人不安的反常现象开始增多。

更糟的是，我们的团结理念开始松动。由于灵能引起的个人主义反常行为增多，集体无法继续高效交流。

如果想恢复秩序，我们就需要清理这些越界现象。
texts.en:
Since allowing the Whisperers to communicate with the [GetBrainName], we have begun to notice a disturbing rise in deviancy amongst the collective.

Worse still, our sense of unity has begun to falter. The collective is unable to communicate effectively due to a psionically induced rise in individualist deviancy.

We must purge these excesses from ourselves if we wish to restore order.

texts.zh: 自从我们邀请虚空之低语进入我们的内心后，异常程序故障和无法解释的暴力行为数量便一直在我们的灵能人口中增长。大部分时候这些都是可以控制的，但最近事情超出了控制。全国各地开始出现秘密集社。有些比较和平无害，但另一些却怀有邪恶的目标，我们社会中的信任开始分崩离析。
texts.en: Ever since we invited the Whisperers into our minds, erratic programming errors and unexplainable acts of violence have been on the rise among our psionic population. For the most part, it has been manageable, but recently issues have escalated beyond our control. Secretive societies have started to appear all over the empire. Some are harmless, but others have more nefarious goals and distrust has become a staple of our society.

texts.zh: 自从我们邀请虚空之低语进入我们的内心后，心理疾病和无法解释的暴力行为数量便一直在我们的灵能人口中增长。大部分时候这些都是可以控制的，但最近事情超出了控制。全国各地开始出现秘密集社。有些比较和平无害，但另一些却怀有邪恶的目标，我们社会中的信任开始分崩离析。
