Some are harmless, but others have more nefarious goals and distrust has become a staple of our society.

texts.zh: [devoured_leader.GetTitle][devoured_leader.GetName]突然失踪，留下的只有灵能活动余波的回响。似乎世界之喰煞乐意以[devoured_leader.GetHimHer]为食。尽管其他领袖从中幸存，但我们仍无法知晓喰煞何时归来索贡。
texts.en: [devoured_leader.GetTitle] [devoured_leader.GetName] has suddenly disappeared, leaving behind only echoes of psionic activity. It appears that the Eater of Worlds has seen fit to devour [devoured_leader.GetHimHer]. Though it spared our other leaders, we cannot predict when the Eater might return for more.

texts.zh: [devoured_leader.GetTitle][devoured_leader.GetName]突然失踪，留下的只有灵能活动余波的回响。我们相信世界之喰煞乐意以[devoured_leader.GetHimHer]为食。我们会想办法弥补损失，并祈祷喰煞能够为此感到饱足一段时间。
texts.en: [devoured_leader.GetTitle] [devoured_leader.GetName] has suddenly disappeared, leaving behind only echoes of psionic activity. We believe that the Eater of Worlds has seen fit to devour [devoured_leader.GetHimHer]. We managed to cover this up, and can only hope that the Eater has been sated for a while.

label.zh: 不过是些不值一提的小代价。

texts.zh:
喰煞又回来索要贡品了，祂吞噬了[planet_target.GetName]上相当多的人口。

虽然我们从与喰煞的契约中获利，但这种对我们集体的肆意剪除开始播下破坏和不稳定的种子，使我们走向分裂。
texts.en:
Once again, the Eater has returned to claim its tribute, devouring a significant part of our population on [planet_target.GetName].

Though we understand the benefits of our covenant with Eater, such rampant cullings of our collective are beginning to sow the seeds of disruption and instability, leaving us more fragmented.

texts.zh:
喰煞又回来索要贡品了，祂吞噬了[planet_target.GetName]上的大量人口。

虽然我们和喰煞的契约对大多数人来说是秘密，但可以理解星球上幸存的人口仍在未知中惊恐，他们对“神秘的失踪”表示愤怒，要求政府作出解释。
texts.en:
Once again, the Eater has returned to claim its tribute, devouring a significant part of the population on [planet_target.GetName].

Though we have been able to keep our covenant with the Eater secret from the population at large, the remaining people on the planet are understandably fearful and angry over these 'mysterious' disappearances and are demanding an explanation from the government.

texts.zh:
喰煞又回来索要贡品了——祂这次吞噬了一整颗行星。

[planet_target.GetName]现在被灵能浓雾笼罩着，其大气层完全无法突破。该星球已经不可宜居，下一次，如果祂降临在另一颗繁荣的星球之上，那将会是人间地狱。
texts.en:
Once again, the Eater has returned to claim its tribute - this time devouring a whole planet.

[planet_target.GetName] is now enveloped in a thick psionic fog, and any attempt to breach the atmosphere has proven unsuccessful. This world was uninhabited; the consequences would be grave if the next target is a thriving colony.

texts.zh: 吞噬者又回来索要他的贡品了，并不满足于夺取我们一部分人口，这次吞噬者吞噬了整个星球。[planet_target.GetName]被一层浓密的灵能雾包裹着，进入大气层的救援船全未能返回。幸运的是，这颗星球尚未被殖民，但对于下一次选中我们兴盛的殖民地这种可能性感到瑟瑟发抖。
texts.en: Once again, the Eater has returned to claim its tribute. Not content to merely claim a part of our population, the Eater has devoured a whole planet. [planet_target.GetName] has been enveloped in a thick psionic fog, and rescue ships sent into the atmosphere have all failed to return. Thankfully, this world was uninhabited, but we shudder at the thought the next one might be one of our thriving colonies.

texts.zh:
器具的影响传遍整个[GetBrainName]，祂超越世俗的欲望用“排他性”、“颓废”和“财富”之类抽象的个人主义概念腐蚀着我们的集体。

这种概念在我们的子个体身上造成了病态，使其偏离原先推动着我们的统一目标。我们可能不得不沉溺于这些恶习来重新凝聚自我。
texts.en:
The influence of the Instrument can be felt throughout the [GetBrainName], its otherworldly desires corrupting our collective with abstract individualist notions such as 'exclusivity', 'decadence', and 'wealth'.

Such concepts are inflicting a sickness throughout our drones, causing them to stray from the unifying purposes that drive us. We may have to indulge in these vices to recollect ourselves.

texts.zh:
在器具对我们程序的影响下产生的欲望正在改写多数人口的逻辑核心。

颓废和消费主义开始降低运作效率，各单位努力为了美学目的而不是预期功能对部件进行复古改造。由此导致的高需求零件短缺导致了整个装配线的小规模冲突。

我们需要提升[GetInstrumentCraving]的产出来缓解这一事态。
texts.en:
The desires emerging from the Instrument's influence on our programming are overriding the logic centres of our populace.

Consumerism and decadence have begun to detract from operational efficiency, with units striving to retro-engineer their parts for aesthetic purposes over their intended functionality. The resulting shortages in high-demand parts have resulted in small skirmishes throughout assembly lines.

We will need to increase production of [GetInstrumentCraving] to settle the issue.

texts.zh:
器具施加的渴求非常强烈。全国的人民开始狂热追求消费主义和腐败，索求更多高级货物，更珍稀更美味的食物。有数个购物街区已经发生了暴动。

我们也许只能被迫增加[GetInstrumentCraving]的产出，以平息众怒。
texts.en:
The desires inflicted by the Instrument are strong. Our population has been caught in a frenzy of consumerism and decadence, demanding ever more exclusive goods, ever rarer and more exotic foods. Rioting has already broken out at several shopping districts.

We might be forced to increase our production of [GetInstrumentCraving] to quieten the masses.

label.en: Such is the cost of success.

texts.zh: 生命之织缕将祂的祝福赐予了我们，直接改变了我们中一部分硬件的组件。电路已经被调整成了新的构造。坚固的金属也不知为何自动重铸成了崭新的形态。值得一提的是我们的神经处理器却功能完好，没有发生一丁点问题。
texts.en: The Composer of Strands has bestowed its blessings upon us, directly altering some of our hardwired components. Circuits have fused into new configurations. Solid metal has somehow melded into totally novel forms. Remarkably, our neuroprocessors remain functioning without the slightest problem.

texts.zh: 生命之织缕将祂的祝福赐予了我们，直接改变了[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]物种的基因编码。奇怪的是，快速且难以预测的变异挑起的只是温和的反应。似乎这种随机而难以预测的变异可以当成生活的一部分，不至于为此感到愤慨，甚至认为这不值一提。
texts.en: The Composer of Strands has bestowed its blessings upon us, directly altering the genetic code of the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] species. Strangely, the rapid and unpredictable mutations have provoked no more than a very muted reaction. It seems the random and unpredictable mutations can be considered a normal part of life, hardly worthy of outrage, or alarm.

texts.zh: 生命之织缕将祂的祝福赐予了我们，直接改变了[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]物种的基因编码。奇怪的是，快速且难以预测的变异挑起的只是温和的反应。似乎我们的人民把随机而难以预测的变异当成了生活的一部分，不至于为此感到愤慨，甚至认为这不值一提。
texts.en: The Composer of Strands has bestowed its blessings upon us, directly altering the genetic code of the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] species. Strangely, the rapid and unpredictable mutations have provoked no more than a very muted reaction. It seems our population has to come to treat the random and unpredictable mutations as little more than a normal part of life, hardly worthy of outrage, or even discussion.

label.en: Let us see what the results are...

texts.zh: 喰煞永远都不可能真正感到饱足。这次，祂啃噬了我们的一个殖民地。我们集体所占据的很大一部分物质空间，只留下了无比巨大的空洞，紫色的迷雾萦绕盘蜷其中。。
texts.en: The Eater can never be truly sated. This time, it took a bite out of one of our colonies. Where once a significant portion of the collective occupied physical space, now all that remains is a crater of unthinkable size, haunted by swirling purple mists.

texts.zh: 喰煞永远都不可能真正感到饱足。这次，祂啃噬了我们的一个殖民地。这颗星球的很大一部分从现实世界消失了，只留下了无比巨大的空洞，紫色的迷雾萦绕盘蜷其中。
texts.en: The Eater can never be truly sated. This time, it took a bite out of one of our colonies. A significant part of the world has vanished from our reality, and now all that remains is a crater of unthinkable size, haunted by swirling purple mists.

label.en: This is the price of power.

texts.zh: 喰煞又回来索要祂的贡品了，祂吞噬了[planet_target.GetName]上的一整座城市。集体以失去了许多子个体为与喰煞的契约付出了高昂的代价。
texts.en: Once again, the Eater has returned to claim its tribute, devouring a whole city on [planet_target.GetName]. With the loss of so many drones, the collective has paid a high price for our covenant with the Eater.

texts.zh: 喰煞又回来索要祂的贡品了，祂吞噬了[planet_target.GetName]上的一整座城市。尽管我们一直对绝大多数人口保守我们与喰煞签订契约的这个秘密，但是星球上剩余的人口在仍对“神秘的失踪”表示愤怒，要求政府作出解释。
texts.en: Once again, the Eater has returned to claim its tribute, devouring a whole city on [planet_target.GetName]. Though we have been able to keep our covenant with the Eater secret from the population at large, those remaining on the planet are dissatisfied over these 'mysterious' disappearances and are demanding an explanation from the government.

texts.zh: 喰煞又回来索要祂的贡品了，祂吞噬了[planet_target.GetName]上的一整座城市。尽管我们一直对绝大多数人口保守我们与喰煞签订契约的这个秘密，星球上剩余的人口在未知中惊恐，并对“神秘的失踪”表示愤怒，要求政府作出解释。
texts.en: Once again, the Eater has returned to claim its tribute, devouring a whole city on [planet_target.GetName]. Though we have been able to keep our covenant with the Eater secret from the population at large, the remaining people on the planet are understandably fearful and angry over these 'mysterious' disappearances and are demanding an explanation from the government.

texts.zh: 生命之织缕的庇佑令人难以捉摸。我们的一位领袖的物理形式很不幸地产生了独立意识。仅一瞬间，它便自行劣化成一团扭曲的血肉。由于根本无法反转这一过程，我们只能认为这位领袖实际上已经去世了。
texts.en: The blessings of the Composer of Strands are unpredictable. One of our leaders had an unfortunate experience when their physical form gained a will of its own. In moments, they had degenerated into an unrecognizable writhing mass. Without any hope of reversing the process, we now consider this leader to be effectively dead.

texts.en: The blessings of the Composer of Strands are unpredictable. One of our leaders had an unfortunate experience when their flesh gained a will of its own. In moments, they had degenerated into an unrecognizable writhing mass. Without any hope of reversing the process, we now consider this leader drone to be effectively dead.

texts.zh: 生命之织缕的庇佑令人难以捉摸。我们的一位领袖的部件很不幸地产生了独立意识。仅一瞬间，它便自行熔化重铸成了一个怪异的新形态。这个领袖现在劣化成了一堆功能故障无法修复的破铜烂铁，对[Root.GetName]已经没有作用了。
texts.en: The blessings of the Composer of Strands are unpredictable. One of our leaders experienced a spectacular critical failure when their physical components gained a will of their own, spontaneously fusing and melding into a bizarre new form. Now reduced to a malfunctioning and irreparable piece of scrap metal, the [Root.GetName] has no further use for this leader.

texts.zh: 生命之织缕的庇佑令人难以捉摸。我们的一位领袖节点发生严重的知名故障，他的部件很不幸地产生了独立意识。仅一瞬间，它便自行熔化重铸成了一个怪异的新形态。这个领袖现在劣化成了一堆功能故障无法修复的破铜烂铁，对[Root.GetName]已经没有作用了。
texts.en: The blessings of the Composer of Strands are unpredictable. One of our leader nodes experienced a spectacular critical failure when their physical components gained a will of their own, spontaneously fusing and melding into a bizarre new form. Now reduced to a malfunctioning and irreparable piece of scrap metal, the [Root.GetName] has no further use for this leader node.

label.zh: 什么硬件都有过时的一天。
label.en: All hardware becomes obsolete one day.

label.zh: 格式塔意识 · 蜂巢思维

texts.zh: 生命之织缕的慷慨恩赐降临到了[devolved_species_planet.GetName]，许多我们的人口发生了严重的变异，退化回了前智慧生物的阶段。
texts.en: The benevolent gifts of the Composer of Strands have fallen upon [devolved_species_planet.GetName], where a number of our populations have undergone a severe mutation, regressing to the state of pre-sapients.

texts.zh: 月窠寻求万物平衡；我们的[GetTelepathPlural]称，这也包含了军事力量与和平需求的平衡。我们的海军规模恐怕激起了超主的愤怒，[demilitarized_fleet.GetFleetName]的一些舰船突然失踪，化为了剧烈的灵能量爆炸。
texts.en: The Cradle seeks balance in all things; according to our [GetTelepathPlural], this includes a military proportionate to the needs of peace. The size of our navy must have stirred our patron's ire, as a number of ships from the [demilitarized_fleet.GetFleetName] have suddenly vanished in a violent burst of psionic energy.

texts.zh: [GetCradleAnguishIntro]存在主义苦痛。
texts.en: [GetCradleAnguishIntro] existential anguish.

texts.zh: [GetCradleAnguishIntro]认知干扰。
texts.en: [GetCradleAnguishIntro] cognitive disruption.

texts.zh:
在[root.GetName]上下，支持维护军事舰队的能力越来越弱。

我们的[GetTelepathPlural]认为这种干扰是月窠造成的，祂渴望着星系的秩序。我们的对军事基础设施的投资哪怕只有一丁点都会引起祂的不满。
texts.en:
The ability to support and maintain our military fleets has become more difficult throughout the [root.GetName].

Our [GetTelepathPlural] sense that this disruption was caused by the Cradle, which yearns for galactic order. Our investment into military infrastructure, no matter how small, must have earned its displeasure.

label.zh: 我们需要限制自己在太空中的存在。
label.en: We should limit our presence in the void.

texts.zh:
我们与器具的纽带导致了一些[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]领袖子个体自愿消费激增。

[lavish_leader.GetName]花费了远超必要的能量来支持[lavish_leader.GetHisHer]的基础功能。由于没有发现任何的物理基础，我们得出结论这种资源浪费在某种程度上是某种优先行为。
texts.en:
Our close bond with the Instrument is causing elevated resource consumption among some [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] leader drones.

[lavish_leader.GetName] has been using more energy than is necessary to support [lavish_leader.GetHisHer] basic functioning. No physical basis for this has been found, leading us to conclude that this indulgent resource use is somehow preferential.

texts.zh:
我们与器具的纽带导致一些[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]领袖染上了奢侈的习惯。

[lavish_leader.GetName]被发现在奢侈品上花费了大量的能量币，以此支持越来越奢靡的私生活。
texts.en:
Our bond with the Instrument is causing some of the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] leadership to develop expensive consumption habits.

[lavish_leader.GetName] has been caught spending vast sums of energy credits on extravagant items, supporting an increasingly indulgent personal lifestyle.

label.en: Such is the cost of desire.

title.zh: 渴求之器具：劳动力涣散

texts.zh:
随着超主在[Root.GetName]的影响进一步扩大，[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]集体的反常度日渐上升。

工作时子个体注意力频繁涣散，使得维持劳动力的团结与服从需要更多投入。
texts.en:
As our patron's influence spreads ever further across [Root.GetName], a creeping deviancy has arisen within the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] collective.

These momentary individualistic urges and propensity to distraction are particularly common during work tasks. Maintaining the cohesion and discipline of the workforce now requires greater investment.

texts.zh:
随着超主在[Root.GetName]的影响进一步扩大，新涌现的娱乐活动吸引了人们的注意力，令他们荒废正业。

由于工作积极性不断下降，如果我们想维持从前的生产效率，就需要付出比之前更多的投入。
texts.en:
As our patron's influence spreads ever further across [Root.GetName], newfound leisure distractions are diverting the population's energy away from productive work.

In the face of waning motivation, achieving the same outputs from the labor force now requires greater investment than before.

label.zh: 不过是器具的突发奇想。
label.en: A temporary whim of the Instrument.

texts.zh: 尽管曾是普通的[chosen_one_species.GetName]而今却已不可同日而语，这位名为[chosen_one.GetName]的[GetImmortalLoc]实体在[Root.GetName]吸引了大量虔诚的信徒。很多人都把他奉为至高神明，我们的政府也已经正式授予他[chosen_one.GetTitle]的称号，并成为了我们伟大帝国永远的统治者，从现在直到永远。
texts.en: The [GetImmortalLoc] entity known as [chosen_one.GetName], previously [chosen_one_species.GetName] but now something far more, has attracted a large and devout following in the [Root.GetName]. Worshipped by many as a supreme deity, a call has gone out to officially crown the [chosen_one.GetTitle] as the permanent ruler of our great empire, now and into perpetuity.

label.zh: 是个强大的灵能者，但是说是神？这就不太可信了。
label.en: A powerful psychic, but a God? Hardly.

label.zh: 陛下千古一帝，万寿无疆
label.en: May [chosen_one.GetHerHis] reign stretch into infinity... and beyond!

texts.zh: [chosen_one_species.GetAdj][GetPsychicNoun]的强大力量夺取了[From.GetName]的控制！这个永续生物的追随者们悄悄地称[chosen_one.GetHerHis]为“天选之人”，今天早上在[From.Capital.GetName]上举行的一场奢华的仪式上加冕登基。随后，所有星际政府都收到了一封庆祝[chosen_one.GetRulerTitle][chosen_one.GetRegnalName]永恒统治的公报。
texts.en: An immensely powerful [chosen_one_species.GetAdj] [GetPsychicNoun] has seized control of the [From.GetName]! This everlasting being, referred to in hushed whispers as the 'Chosen One' by [chosen_one.GetHerHis] followers, was crowned on [From.Capital.GetName] in a lavish ceremony this morning. A communique celebrating the eternal rule of [chosen_one.GetRulerTitle] [chosen_one.GetRegnalName] was sent out to all interstellar governments shortly thereafter.

texts.zh: [chosen_one_species.GetAdj][GetPsychicNoun]的强大力量夺取了[From.GetName]的控制！这个不朽生物的追随者们悄悄地称[chosen_one.GetHerHis]为“天选之人”，今天早上在[From.Capital.GetName]上举行的一场奢华的仪式上加冕登基。随后，所有星际政府都收到了一封庆祝[chosen_one.GetRulerTitle][chosen_one.GetRegnalName]永恒统治的公报。
texts.en: An immensely powerful [chosen_one_species.GetAdj] [GetPsychicNoun] has seized control of the [From.GetName]! This immortal being, referred to in hushed whispers as the 'Chosen One' by [chosen_one.GetHerHis] followers, was crowned on [From.Capital.GetName] in a lavish ceremony this morning. A communique celebrating the eternal rule of [chosen_one.GetRulerTitle] [chosen_one.GetRegnalName] was sent out to all interstellar governments shortly thereafter.

label.en: [chosen_one.GetName] has been touched by the Shroud.

texts.zh:
我们与一位名为虚空之低语的虚境实体建立了纽带。伴随着莫测的感觉，它索取一定代价赐予我们零星力量。这样的交换应该还会有更多。

我们的[GetTelepathPlural]总结道，如果将我们的行为与超主保持一致，这条纽带将更容易被加强。

低语享受新的知识、沉默的秘密和阴谋。祂们陶醉于一种简单的快乐，这种快乐充满了头脑，在接缝处开裂。
texts.en:
We have created a bond with a Shroud entity named the Whisperers in the Void. Unfathomable, it granted us crumbs of its power for a price. There will likely be more to follow.

Our [GetTelepathPlural] theorize that the bond can be deepened more easily if we align our actions with the will of our patron.

The Whisperers enjoy new knowledge, silent secrets, and conspiracies. They revel in the simple joy of a mind filled to the brim, cracking at the seams.

texts.zh:
我们与一个名为世界之喰煞的虚境实体建立了纽带。祂索取一定代价赐予我们零星力量。这样的交换应该还会有更多。

我们的[GetTelepathPlural]推论，只看我们的行为与超主的意志相调和，这条纽带就会进一步加强。

喰煞无厌而饥渴。祂渴望战争、冲突和哀嚎的甜美。
texts.en:
We have created a bond with a Shroud entity named the Eater of Worlds. Insatiable, it granted us crumbs of its power for a price. There will likely be more to follow.

Our [GetTelepathPlural] theorize that the bond can be deepened more easily if we align our actions with the will of our patron.

The Eater hungers impatiently. It craves war, the sweet taste of strife and lament.

texts.zh:
我们与一位名为生命之织缕的虚境实体建立了纽带。伴随着荫蔽的感觉，祂索取一定代价赐予我们零星力量。这样的交换应该还会有更多。

我们的[GetTelepathPlural]推论，只看我们的行为与超主的意志相调和，这条纽带就会进一步加强。

织缕渴求基因操控和将血肉从进化的桎梏中解脱。祂教导我们对敬畏生命和自然，以及血肉的神圣性。
texts.en:
We have created a bond with a Shroud entity named the Composer of Strands. Sheltering, it granted us crumbs of its power for a price. There will likely be more to follow.

Our [GetTelepathPlural] theorize that the bond can be further deepened more easily if we align our actions with the will of our patron.

The Composer yearns for genetic manipulations and flesh set free from the constraints of evolution. It tells us about respect for life and nature, and the sanctity of the flesh.

texts.zh:
我们与一个名为渴求之器具的虚境实体建立了纽带。祂索取一定代价赐予我们零星力量。这样的交换应该还会有更多。

我们的[GetTelepathPlural]推论，只看我们的行为与超主的意志相调和，这条纽带就会进一步加强。

器具渴求着渴求本身。沉溺享乐、腐化和奴役便是器具的别名。
texts.en:
We have created a bond with a Shroud entity named the Instrument of Desire. Pampering, it granted us crumbs of its power for a price. There will likely be more to follow.

Our [GetTelepathPlural] theorize that the bond can be deepened more easily if we align our actions with the will of our patron.

The Instrument longs for yearning. Indulged pleasures, decadence, and slavery spell the name of the Instrument.

texts.zh:
我们与轮回之终末的契约给[this.GetName]带来了毁灭，余下的只有我们往昔强盛帝国的断壁残垣。

超主的破坏欲具现化为一个强大的能量生物——最终清算。它在星球之间漫游，吞噬人口来重获自己的力量。
texts.en:
Our Covenant with the End of the Cycle led to the destruction of the [this.GetName], leaving behind only a vestige of our once-powerful empire.

The destructive intent of our former patron has now taken form as an immense energy being - the Reckoning. It moves from world to world, restoring its strength by consumption of their populations.

texts.zh: [event_target:the_reckoning_observer_target.GetName]的清算正在给整个星系带来浩劫！
texts.en: The Reckoning of the [event_target:the_reckoning_observer_target.GetName] is wreaking havoc upon the galaxy!

texts.zh: 有许多被称为最终清算的实体正在给星系带来浩劫！
texts.en: Multiple entities known as Reckonings are wreaking havoc upon the galaxy!

texts.zh:
我们已经与轮回之终末签订了契约，获得了无上力量。我们的[Owner.GetTelepathPlural]们认为，这笔交易的代价可以通过集体灵能出神来推迟——但只能推迟这么长时间。

超主的意志将会化为强力的灵能光环降临。如果我们想实现终末，就要把散播这个光环作为我们的终极目标。随着我们愈发人多势众，心智之力也在增长，光环的力量和范围也会随之扩大。

有待征服的恒星系：[Owner.GetEndCycleGalaxySystemsLeft]
texts.en:
We have forged a Covenant with the End of the Cycle, granting us overwhelming power. Our [Owner.GetTelepathPlural] theorize that the cost of our bargain can be deferred by collective psionic trance - but only for so long.

The will of our patron is manifested in an intense Psionic Aura. If we intend to realize the End, the spread of this Aura must be our ultimate goal. As our numbers grow, and the strength of our minds increases, so too will the Aura's power and reach.

Systems remaining to be conquered: [Owner.GetEndCycleGalaxySystemsLeft]

texts.zh:
我们与轮回之终末签订契约，赐予我们无上伟力，并赋予我们神圣使命。

超主的意志要求彻底湮灭此方现实。终末光环每吞噬一个星系，便让慈悲的湮灭更近一步。

吾等将见证这必然的终局。

待征服星系数量：[Owner.GetEndCycleGalaxySystemsLeft]
texts.en:
Our Covenant with the End of the Cycle grants us untold power, and tasks us with glorious purpose.

The will of our patron demands complete annihilation of this reality. With each system the Aura of the End consumes, the closer merciful oblivion comes to pass.

We shall bear witness to inevitability.

Systems remaining to be conquered: [Owner.GetEndCycleGalaxySystemsLeft]

texts.zh: 如果我们要和被称为“虚境”的灵能领域中的居民交流的话，我们必须释放一股难以想象的巨大灵能能量。一场巨大的降灵会已做好筹备，[Root.Capital.GetName]新建的灵能使密会所里最强大的通灵者们将参与其中。
texts.en: If we are to communicate with the denizens of the psychic realm known as the Shroud, we will have to unleash an incredible amount of psionic energy. Preparations have been made for a huge séance involving our most powerful psychics in the newly established Conclave of Telepaths on [Root.Capital.GetName].

texts.zh: [Root.Capital.GetName]上的灵能使集会所正在准备一场盛大的圣餐以探寻一位深居虚境中的实体。
texts.en: The Conclave of Telepaths on [Root.Capital.GetName] is preparing a great communion to reach out to an entity that dwells in the Shroud.
